extra 3
programme.desc: 1976 von Dieter Kronzucker erfunden, legt „extra 3“ beständig den Finger in die Wunde. Ob falsche Wahlversprechen, Finanz- und Wirtschaftsskandale oder dämliche TV-Magazine, die Beiträge entlarven politischen und gesellschaftlichen Irrsinn auf so witzige, intelligent-makabre Weise, dass das Einschalten immer wieder lohnt.

programme.title: Willkommen Österreich
programme.desc: Österreichische Late-Night-Show, moderiert von Dirk Stermann und Christoph Grissemann. "Willkommen Österreich" präsentiert mit dem sprühenden Charme der Abgeklärtheit provokante Themen und schwarzen Humor – fernab von Political Correctness. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Christian Ehring: Nebensaison. Das Musikprogramm
programme.desc: Worte kann er. programme.title: Der Engel mit der Posaune

programme.title: Wild Bavaria

programme.desc: Mighty and mysterious, King Watzmann sits above Germany's only alpine national park.

programme.title: mareTV: Capri and the Amalfi Coast - Italy's Ocean Legends
programme.desc: Capri was already in ancient times a place for the rich and beautiful. Today Capri is one of the most famous islands in the world. Millions of tourists visit it. But there are in fact still unknown corners on the island in the Gulf of Naples. Thus, at the very top of Capri, there is a hermit monastery with a view to the Vesuvius.

programme.title: mareTV: Martinique
programme.desc: The island of Martinique is a piece of France in the Caribbean, between Florida and South America. And of course, Savoir-vivre applies just as it does on the other side of the Atlantic, between the English Channel and the Mediterranean. Jacky Pascault is the first and only man to cultivate mushrooms in the Caribbean. Everywhere else, they grow on artificially fertilised soil, but Jacky's Champignons Tropicaux flourish on sugar cane fibres. Nicole Vilo tailors hats and dresses out of coconut palms. Of course, the catwalk for the models wearing her first collection is one of the countless dream beaches. The Martiniquais sail on boats they call Yole, which have no keel and are therefore difficult to navigate. The crew members hang over the water in breakneck fashion on long wooden poles. Just the job for Yole-boss Max' "problem kids": they not only learn complicated handling, but also team spirit.

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.sub-title: The Psychogramm of a Spiritual Landscape
programme.desc: The Bohemian Forest is the source of the Vltava River, home to primeval forests, untouched high moors and bubbling torrents. This archaic stretch of land, which includes the Bavarian Forest, was long considered impenetrable and mysterious. Since the fall of the Iron Curtain, Bavarian border residents have rediscovered new references to this unusual forest landscape for themselves. This is also the case with photo artist Bastian Kalous, who has been documenting his homeland for years with nostalgic-looking Polaroid photographs and is dealing with its eventful history for an illustrated book. Or Elisa Belotti and Marco Heurich, who have dedicated their lives to the lynxes. In order for Europe's largest wild cat to survive in the Bohemian Forest, the lynx researchers fight for every single animal. Iryna Rudenko came to Zwiesel from Ukraine out of a passion for glass as a material to study at the glass school. After graduation, she would like to stay in Bavaria, Anna Hones grew up in Horská Kvilda, the smallest and highest village in the Czech Republic. The village lies just under 1100 meters above sea level, directly on the former border. The farmer, who experienced communism, the fall of the Iron Curtain and the subsequent changes, is now trying to find ways of surviving in this barren region with her children.

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.desc: Pavel Hubeny, whose life would be unthinkable without the forest, is the head of the Šumava National Park. He is committed to ensuring that a primeval forest can grow for future generations, in which man does not interfere. This vision of a primeval forest is also shared by the forester Claus Bässler, who wants to counteract the extinction of species by having trees felled to create artificial deadwood and thus a new habitat for rare beetles and fungi. On the Vltava River lies the small town of Krumlov, the "Pearl of the Bohemian Forest" with its Baroque theater and fully preserved stage technology from the 17th century. Here the director Zuzana Vrbová enchants people from all over the world with her productions. Apart from agriculture, it was mainly the abundance of forests that ensured the livelihood of the inhabitants of the Bohemian Forest - including that of the carpenter Philipp von Manz, who processed local wood for his customers all over Germany. Veterinarian Judith Gollner, who grew up in the Austrian part of the Bohemian Forest, lived in Vienna for a long time and made a conscious decision to return. She likes the people and is proud of "her farmers' wives" who share her love of the Bohemian Forest.

programme.title: Dust And Stripes
programme.desc: In a never-ending quest for grass and water, the striped herds undertake an annual epic trek across the vast lunar landscape of the Kalahari’s Makgadikgadi Pans. Most of the year, the Makgadikgadi is an inhospitable wasteland of windswept, salt-encrusted pans. For the area’s water-dependent zebra, the Boteti River on the western edge of the pans is a dry-season lifeline. However, it is also a death trap, with lions waiting in ambush and crocodiles lurking in dark riverside caves.

programme.title: mareTV: The Eckernförde Bay - Beach shooters, mine clearance divers, squirrels
programme.desc: Fjord, ford, bay, gulf: there are many names for the beautiful extensions of the Baltic Sea into the country. Eckernförde Bay is shaped by currents, surf and people. It stretches 17 kilometers to the town that gives it its name. Stephan Möller is the acting shooting master of the Eckernförder Bürgerschützengilde. He spent a whole year preparing the beach shooting festival and then this: fog, rain and a stiff breeze. Traditionally, the Eckernförde marksmen always shoot at a wooden bird in the direction of the sea at Whitsun. Under strict conditions! And these stipulate a clear view of at least one kilometer out into the bay. The event literally threatens to fall through, for the first time in 449 years. Around 3,000 soldiers are stationed at the Eckernförde naval base, but only a small group is allowed to call itself an elite unit: the mine divers. They are considered the toughest soldiers in the Navy. Anyone who wants to be one of them has to undergo extreme training. This year, just two candidates made it to the final round. Now they still have to pass the dreaded final exam: running 20 kilometers with marching gear and then swimming ten kilometers through Eckernförde Bay.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.sub-title: On the Ohio River with the “Belle of Louisville”
programme.desc: Idlewild - Avalon - Belle of Louisville - these three names stand for the last still roadworthy, historic sternwheeler in the USA. In 1914, the ship was built as "Idlewild" for the West Memphis Packet Company as a passenger ferry. With a draft of only 1.50 m and a robust steel hull, the boat is suitable for almost all navigable rivers of the Mississippi River system. Today, the "Belle" is the most traveled steamboat in American history. In the course of her eventful life, she has called at 130 places in 19 states.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: The paddle steamer "Skibladner" is the oldest passenger paddle steamer in the world in regular service. It has been plying Norway's largest inland lake, the Mjøsa, since 1856. The "white swan" has a melodious name, borrowed from Norse mythology. The ship "Skíðblaðnir" of the god Freyr, built by dwarves, could always have a tail wind, could be stowed in a small bag when folded and all gods in armor had room on it. The traditional ship of AS Oplandandske Dampskibsselskap does not have such fairy-tale powers, but atmospherically the "Skibladner" also transports guests to a world long gone.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: With a length of more than 1000 kilometers, the Elbe is one of the largest rivers in Europe. The river has shaped landscapes since time immemorial: geologically, economically and culturally. One of the most beautiful sections of the river - in Saxony in southeastern Germany - has been navigated by the Saxon Steamship Company since 1836. One of its most beautiful ships is the Diesbar. Its engine is considered the oldest paddle steamer engine still in use in the world, the ship is the only steamer in the fleet still powered by coal.

programme.title: mareTV: Curacao, Blue Wonder of the Caribbean
programme.desc: Curacao is one of the most popular attractions for countless cruise ships on their trips through the Caribbean, because it is located outside of the hurricane belt. This is why Eric Miguel is constantly in action. He is the bridge keeper of the Queen Emma Bridge, the landmark of Curacao's capital, Willemstad. After his shift, Eric goes to Yvonne Troeman's cook-shop. Her speciality is Kadushi, a cactus soup. The ingredients include cactus flesh, pigtail's, mussels and a few secret "treats". Barbara van Bebber is the only submarine pilot on Curacao and literally gets to the bottom of things amidst the turquoise-blue wonder of the Caribbean. She charters out her sub to marine biologists and wealthy private explorers, simultaneously cleaning up on the seabed. Her "Curasub" has claw arms, which she employs to remove anything that doesn't belong down there: beer bottles, car tyres, and plastic refuse. Jeroen Eikelenboom simply carts sand from a neighbouring cove to his own surf club in his favourite bay.

programme.title: mareTV: Venice - Lagoon and Legend
programme.desc: Venice has been attracting people as if by magic for centuries. The Italians call her La Serenissima, or the sublime. Perched on wooden posts, she braves the elements and the huge, annual surge of visitors. Vogalonga is the name of a Venetian sports competition for women, in which the participants row their boats standing. This is a tradition that Guilia and Elena also follow. They train hard, as the yearly regatta is soon to begin. Anyone caught driving their water vehicle with more than 7 km/h through the canals of Venice, risks getting a ticket from local policewoman Lorenza Mariutti. The reason: the resulting waves gnaw at the foundations of the grand palaces. Venetians are very attached to their traditional cuisine. The island of Sant' Erasmo is the town's garden. Artichokes, radicchio, onions, everything that grows here is said to taste fantastic, thanks to the salt content of the air and water. Carlo and Claudio Finotello not only grow the vegetables, they even deliver directly to their customers' doors. At sunset, they sail through the lagoon with their boat, brimming with produce, towards San Marco. People waiting at the many bridges, now receive their wares: regional, seasonal, fresh. And without a hint of stress if possible. Like so many other things in Venice. Perhaps because La Serenissima is also known as "The Composed".

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Gauja National Park in Latvia features diverse wildlife, red sandstone cliffs and a winding river that flows through forests shaped by long human history.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: The Curonian Spit is a narrow peninsula of dunes and forests shaped by destruction and recovery through careful human intervention.

programme.title: Masai Mara: The Big Hunt
programme.desc: When food supply in the Serengeti dwindles, the Masai Mara is a paradise for predators. As the black wildebeests, gazelles, zebras and antelopes make their yearly trip from the south of the Serengeti to the north, nature’s best laid trap, the Mara River in Kenya is waiting ahead. Captivating shots filmed under water show how crocodiles prepare for the Big Hunt while other predators lurk on the banks awaiting their bounty. The biggest problems for the migratory animals are the Mara and the Tarek River, where they have to put their lives at risk to get to the other side. A great number of them die as they jump into the river and break their legs, while others are carried away by the drift or drown. Those who are not victims of the river itself risk falling prey to the crocodiles. We entered this unchartered territory, the crocodile domain by heading under water. Follow these predators in and around their habitat and watch prides of lions map out their game plan. In slow-motion, we show you the final showdown between predator and prey. Will it be a successful hunt or will the hoofed animals persevere?

programme.title: The Moor
programme.desc: Moors and peatlands are oases in the cultivated landscape of Central Europe.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: The Grand Canyon is a steep-sided canyon carved by the Colorado River in Arizona, United States. The Grand Canyon is 277 miles (446 km) long, up to 18 miles (29 km) wide and attains a depth of over a mile (6,093 feet or 1,857 meters). The canyon and adjacent rim are contained within Grand Canyon National Park, the Kaibab National Forest, Grand Canyon–Parashant National Monument, the Hualapai Indian Reservation, the Havasupai Indian Reservation and the Navajo Nation. President Theodore Roosevelt was a major proponent of preservation of the Grand Canyon area and visited it on numerous occasions to hunt and enjoy the scenery.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: Madeira - Portugal's autonomous island in the Atlantic Ocean, is closer to the African coast than to the mother country Portugal, from which it is separated by about 900 kilometers. The island's name comes from Portuguese sailors who claimed the uninhabited isle for themselves in 1419. Madeira means wood and that was available in abundance. Almost the entire surface was covered by dense forest. Since 1982, two-thirds of the landscape has been protected.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yellowstone National Park is an American national park located in the western United States, largely in the northwest corner of Wyoming and extending into Montana, and Idaho. It was established by the U.S. Congress and signed into law by President Ulysses S. Grant on March 1, 1872. Yellowstone was the first national park in the U.S. and is also widely held to be the first national park in the world. The park is known for its wildlife and its many geothermal features, especially Old Faithful geyser, one of its most popular. While it represents many types of biomes, the subalpine forest is the most abundant. It is part of the South Central Rockies forests ecoregion.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: North America’s National Parks are world famous and their breathtaking landscapes fascinate millions of visitors. This spectacular series will show you what happens beyond the lookouts. Everglades National Park is an American national park that protects the southern twenty percent of the original Everglades in Florida. The park is the largest tropical wilderness in the United States, and the largest wilderness of any kind east of the Mississippi River. An average of one million people visit the park each year. Everglades is the third-largest national park in the contiguous United States after Death Valley and Yellowstone. UNESCO declared the Everglades & Dry Tortugas Biosphere Reserve in 1976, and listed the park as a World Heritage Site in 1979, while the Ramsar Convention included the park on its list of Wetlands of International Importance in 1987. Everglades is one of only three locations in the world to appear on all three lists.

programme.title: mareTV: Newfoundland - Canada's Eastern Point
programme.desc: In Newfoundland, at the easternmost tip of North America, the landscape is pristine, dramatic, and very sparsely populated. In summer, icebergs occasionally drift along the steep cliffs. When the "Titanic" collided with an iceberg and sank just 300 miles off the coast of Newfoundland in 1912, the last radio messages were picked up in a small wooden hut on the Avalon Peninsula. Today, most Newfoundlanders live on Avalon. There are particularly many seabirds here. In Witless Bay, the newborn puffins are ready for their first descent into the Atlantic. But some stray onto the coastal road, attracted by the lights of the hotels and restaurants. In doing so, they run the risk of being run over. A team of volunteers saves the lives of countless young birds: The Puffin & Petrel Patrol goes out at night dressed in high-visibility vests to collect the puffins. Biologist Sabrina Wilhelm then brings them back to Green Island, home to the largest puffin colony in North America. Here, the birds catch up on what they should have done long ago: the first dive of their lives.

programme.title: Magical Moors
programme.desc: Wide open heaths, windswept and barren in winter, are transformed into wonderful carpets of white, fluffy cotton grass in summer. Large bears and wolves roam alongside delicately fluttering butterflies, the bubbling calls of black grouse and the enchanting trills of the great snipe. Moors, bogs and wetlands can be found all over in Europe. Everyone has at least heard about this habitat but most know little about it. It is an ancient yet largely unknown set of landscapes that is full of enchanting surprises. On a warm spring day, poisonous adders emerge from hiding to perform their impressive mating dance. As dusk falls, snipe gather on traditional leks, leaping and singing to impress the opposite sex. And deep down in the boggy marshes, glittering emeralds of sticky dew lure insects into the deadly arms of meat-eating plants. Magical Moors captures the quiet beauty of a spectacular landscape, and its often elusive wildlife, in stunning detail.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: It is one of the wildest roads in Asia: the Trans Sulawesi Highway. The adventurous road leads through Indonesia's fourth-largest island and takes people to spectacular destinations. To beautiful beaches, turbulent cities, or unique primeval forests.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Far out in the "Wild West" of Canada lies Bella Coola. If you want to get to the small town on the Pacific, you have no choice: there is only one road leading there, the Bella Coola Highway. It is constantly monitored and yet remains dangerous. Gravel roads, narrow hairpin bends and steep mountain slopes make the highway in British Columbia a particular challenge.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In the extreme north-east of Norway known as the Finnmark region, winters are freezing cold and snowy. Due to the location on the Arctic Ocean, the roads are prone to snow drifts. Every metre is a challenge and a journey into risk. An adventure for all those who set off into the fascinating and unique landscape, through a seemingly endless desert of snow.

programme.title: The most spectacular change of seasons - Spring
programme.desc: This film explores Central Europe and presents the nature from a perspective you have never seen before. Fascinating landscape footage in high-quality HD technology, coupled with spectacular Cineflex aerial views, take us on a journey through the hitherto unknown blazes of colour of the Central European region and its inhabitants. We show you paradise on earth and demonstrate how climate and astronomy determine our life cycle. While seasons change, we visit several different European habitats that - in their diversity, are exemplary of a Central European region. Mountains, water, forests and meadows: we return to each of these habitats at different times of the year and show how the rhythm of life of each of our protagonists follows nature's clock. The four seasons determine all of the coming and passing away; a highly complex interplay in the universe of life. We explore the wondrous worlds of the mysterious cycle of nature together with extraordinary people. Breathtaking landscapes enable us to experience the change of seasons at first hand.

programme.title: The Sun - Inferno in the Sky
programme.desc: On July 23rd, 2012, a massive eruption on the sun hurls a colossal cloud of solar matter into space. It’s the most severe sunstorm in 150 years. Fortunately, the Earth is not in the direct path of this solar ejection. But it’s only a matter of time before a violent solar storm hits us. When these clouds of charged matter reach our planet, they can wreak havoc in electrical systems.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: Madeira - Portugal's autonomous island in the Atlantic Ocean, is closer to the African coast than to the mother country Portugal, from which it is separated by about 900 kilometers. The island's name comes from Portuguese sailors who claimed the uninhabited isle for themselves in 1419. Madeira means wood and that was available in abundance. Almost the entire surface was covered by dense forest. Since 1982, two-thirds of the landscape has been protected.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The highest mountain range in Portugal is the Serra da Estrela. The episode embarks on a voyage of discovery to adventurous rock formations and villages steeped in tradition. The nature park is the largest protected area on the Iberian peninsula. In the mountain range we accompany the young scientist Ana Matos, who wants to breathe new life into old traditions, and cheese maker Maria Natália Lopes. She watches over more than 350 sheeps.

programme.title: Wild Alpine Rivers - Life in the Extreme
programme.desc: What would happen to the mountains without water? They would turn into deserts, devoid of life and vegetation. But there are very few mountains without water on our planet. They take care of this themselves, creating their life’s element and taking water directly from the sky by entrapping the clouds around them. This water then collects on the flanks of the mountains, where it turns from rivulets into rivers, that flow out into the oceans. Mountains and water are symbiotic, a cycle that keeps life on earth going. Mountain streams slowly move along meadows before, only moments later, turning into the spray of waterfalls or small mystic lakes. What kind of life can be found in and around this mysterious cosmos? We will investigate the world of the rare Danube salmon and be there to see the Danube bleak spawn. We will follow giant wels catfish into their hideouts, see great crested grebes on their underwater hunting. We go diving under the ice of frozen mountain streams and lakes, discovering life where none was thought possible.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Apes and Aliens
programme.desc: The Congo, mighty and deep like no other river - yet still a retreat and a habitat for several of our world's strangest animals. Our closest relatives live deep inside the dense jungles: three of the four giant ape species have made the Congo basin their home. Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Deep and Dangerous
programme.desc: The river that swallows all rivers - this is what the natives call it. In reality, the Congo, when considering its water masses, is the second largest and the deepest river in the world. At its source in the north of Zambia, it starts out as a mere trickle, but on its journey westwards it grows and grows, becoming ever mightier and with it, the animals, too: the shoebill stork hides in the dense papyrus. Metre-long pythons hunt for their prey in trees and huge hippos fight for power and respect in the water. To survive in the Congo, animals have to adapt to extreme conditions. Here, evolution has spawned unique creatures: fish with lungs, wings and those that go hunting on land. The Congo River feeds the second largest rainforest on earth. Here is the home of the forest elephant. Time and again, they are summoned to this one, magic place: the Dzanga Bay. Countless other forest dwellers join them. What makes this place so special?

programme.title: mareTV: Sardinia - Magical Island in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Sardinia is the second-largest island in the Mediterranean. The Sardin-ians themselves say it's a "continent for itself", a virtual world of its own, full of magic: A beach, gleaming in unreal pink shades, red corals protect against the evil eye and the inhabitants seem to remain forever young. On Sardinia, the owners of luxury yachts adopt sheep, fish have gold in their bellies and a giant mussel supplies the material for legendary sea silk. No one is surprised, that the Madonna goes on a sea cruise once a year.

programme.title: Bavarian Forest - Deep, Dark and Enchanted
programme.desc: After an unusual mass reproduction of bark beetles in the nineties, thousands hectares of old spruce forest were destroyed. Soon after, a new, healthier forest started to grow – a new primeval forest. Within a few years, in place of the former monoculture, a diverse forest developed, rich in spruces, ashes, beech and fir trees. Naturally, this diversity has in turn attracted new animal and plant species. Even lynx and otters returned and made Bavaria their home again.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Some risks on these autoroutes have natural causes: Extreme weather, avalanches and landslides. In some areas, the locals even believe that evil spirits kill travelers. But many of the dangers are man-made: robbers or terrorists lie in wait for travelers, and tough labor pressures, social hardship and greedy mass-transit businesses also cause tragic driving accidents around the world. In the 20th century alone, 35 million people died on roads worldwide - plus 1.5 billion injured! With the two-part "Death Roads - On the Road at the Limit," phoenix offers a documentary road movie along the world's most dangerous car routes.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Roads are much more than just gray strips of asphalt that allow us to travel and trade. For centuries they have been lifelines of mankind, full of stories and history - and in certain countries and areas they also hold great dangers, much human suffering and death. Documentary filmmaker Oliver G. Becker ventured onto dangerous roads in New Zealand, Scotland and Australia for phoenix.

programme.title: mareTV: Corsica - Fascinating Mountain World in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Corsica looks like an alpine landscape in the Mediterranean, an island with dramatic rock formations, romantic bays and proud inhabitants who see themselves first and foremost as Corsicans and only then as French. The Greeks in ancient times called the island Kalliste: the beautiful. We explore this fascinating mountain world in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland - Winter in the Swiss Alps
programme.desc: In the heart of Europe lies Switzerland. It’s a surprisingly big little country: small in area, but big on natural beauty. And, like its many languages and cultures, its scenic diversity is something really special, too: from mighty Alps, dense forests and lush green valleys, to mysterious moors and roaring waterfalls. Mediterranean lakes and craggy rock landscapes are all close together in one small geographical location. Switzerland has many wild faces – some familiar and some hidden. It’s a country that’s astonishingly rich in variety, wilderness and scenic wonder. Each episode of the series seeks to do justice to this diversity.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: A few thousand years ago, there were bare moraine ridges and barren meltwater valleys here. A landscape born in the last ice age, characterized by the edge of the Alps, gentle hills, moors, and lakes. And by cultural richness, not only on the islands in Lake Chiemsee, with their famous monasteries and castles. Long before King Ludwig II, the first people settled in the Chiemgau region. Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: Project Antarctica
programme.desc: Why don't you do something sensible? - Tim, Michael and Dennis have heard this sentence more than once since their school days when they professed their dream jobs: Artist, photographer, filmmaker. And they went on to say that some dreams had to remain dreams, that work didn't have to be fun, but above all that it had to pay enough and be safe. A few years later, the three are working on their joint feature film. They put all their eggs in one basket and are determined to invest two years of working time to achieve their goal. Unpaid. It's not just any goal: the three want to travel to Antarctica. They want to find out whether it is possible to reach even the most distant destinations if you only want to. With ten boxes full of equipment, they set off on the 14,000 km journey to Antarctica. And thus on the journey of a lifetime...

programme.title: 鹿鼎记 / Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: 烈探 / Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: 七小福 / Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong’s biggest stars

programme.title: 珠光宝气 / Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: 殭尸先生 / Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: 缘份 / Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: 火云邪神之修罗面具 / The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

programme.title: 逃学威龙 / Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: 武状元苏乞儿 / King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar’s gang when he saves the gang’s elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Haunted Mountains: The Yellow Taboo
programme.desc: A photographer and his friends enter a remote mountain, unaware it's a forbidden area. Soon, a boy in a yellow raincoat appears, and eerie events begin to unveil the mountain's ancient curse.

programme.title: One More Chance
programme.desc: Chow Yun-Fat plays the unlucky gambler Chui Sui-Fai, whose ex-girlfriend asks him to take care of their autistic son. He reluctantly agreed and the two slowly begin to build their relationship.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: A photographer becomes entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives. When the girl he likes dies mysteriously, he uncovers the secret of a 'ghost marriage'.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: The White Storm 2: Drug Lords
programme.desc: Drug lord Jizo joins forces with Mexican cartels, throwing Hong Kong's drug underworld into chaos. Determined to eradicate narcotics, billionaire Yu Shun Tin offers a HK$100 million bounty on drug traffickers while concealing a dark bond with Jizo. As their shared past resurfaces, an explosive showdown becomes inevitable.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other’s true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: The Myth
programme.desc: Guided by mysterious dreams, archaeologist Jack discovers he was General Meng Yi in a past life and shared a tragic love with Princess Ok-Soo that spanned a thousand years. When they reunite in Emperor Qin's celestial palace, a ruthless tycoon seeks the secret of immortality. Reclaiming his past strength, Jack faces a final battle of destiny.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao’s enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei’s possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world boxing champion Fai meets the passionate young fighter Qi in Macau and agrees to train him for an upcoming MMA tournament. As mentor and student push themselves to the limit, Fai rediscovers his love for fighting, regains his passion for life, and learns to cherish the people who matter most.

programme.title: Hail the Judge
programme.desc: A low level magistrate is run out of town for defending a beautiful murder suspect. Through a series of comedic events he ascends to the top rank & returns looking for revenge.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times

programme.title: Futurama

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: De fotografía
programme.desc: Una adolescente de Modesto, California desapareció. No había señales de lucha en su casa y la policía sospechaba que ella simplemente se había escapado.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando una estudiante universitaria desaparece, sus compañeros de clase estaban preocupados por la seguridad de ella y la de ellos.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En un tranquilo pueblo de Gran Bretaña, un granjero se encuentra con una apariencia escalofriante. Empalado en el poste de la cerca hay una cabeza de cordero cortada y una nota que dice: Usted es el próximo.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Una niña de 13 años desapareció de su casa en Colorado y la única evidencia que dejó el secuestrador fueron tres huellas digitales en la cortina de una ventana.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un hombre desaparece un año después de haber comenzado una aventura con la esposa de su amigo.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Intruso Invisible
programme.desc: En 1996, la policía recibió una llamada de Darlie Routier informándoles de los asesinatos de sus hijos. La policía encontró al asesino tras analizar las salpicaduras de sangre, haciendo perfiles de comportamiento y analizando la llamada al 911 de Darlie.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Después de que aparecen 10 cuerpos en Florida, una víctima – Lisa McVey de 17 años de edad – es secuestrada pero liberada. Ella lleva a la policía al autor del crimen, Bobbie Joe Long.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: El fuego envuelve la casa donde Lori Keidel y sus hermanos se quedaron solos mientras su padre iba a la lavandería. Años después de la desaparición de su madre, Lori le dice a la policía que fue testigo de la muerte de su madre.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Los síntomas parecidos a los de la gripe de una madre y sus hijos resultan ser algo más grave: intoxicación por talio. Después de la muerte de la madre, los investigadores centran su atención en encontrar al asesino.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando dos mujeres desaparecieron y luego fueron encontradas brutalmente asesinadas, la policía se preguntó si fueron víctimas de un crimen de odio.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando la policía encuentra el cuerpo de Krista Harrison, de 11 años, hay pocas pistas sobre la identidad del asesino. Pero las autoridades están intrigadas por las inusuales fibras naranjas incrustadas en la ropa que se encuentran cerca de la víctima.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Marcado de por vida
programme.desc: Un hombre que había cometido delitos, incluido el asesinato, no fue capturado. Casi 50 años después, los avances en la tecnología y el análisis de la escritura descubrieron al criminal.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Rompecabezas de plástico
programme.desc: Un hombre que iba en bicicleta resultó herido de muerte y la policía creía que había sido víctima de un accidente de atropello y fuga.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando un policía fuera de servicio murió de un disparo, sus colegas oficiales estaban determinados a resolver el crimen.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: El pensamiento rápido de un investigador lo ayuda a capturar una huella de zapato hecha en la nieve antes de que la evidencia se desvanezca.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 2008, la respuesta de emergencia de Illinois atendió un incendio en un garaje y se encontró a un hombre aplastado debajo de un camión.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando una joven fue encontrada muerta, la policía arrestó rápidamente al sospechoso más probable. Pero la tecnología de punta de la NASA permitió a un odontólogo forense demostrar que el hombre equivocado estaba tras las rejas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Robert Sims regresa a casa después de trabajar en el turno de noche y encuentra a su esposa inconsciente en el piso de la cocina. Su hijo está profundamente dormido en una habitación de arriba, pero su hija de seis semanas, Heather, no está.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Las vida cambia después de 20 años de haber transcurrido un crimen sin resolver, y lo mismo ocurre con la medicina forense. Hoy en día, un microscopio de alto poder y el perfil de ADN, revelan una pista que nadie había visto antes.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando se encuentra un auto en una zanja de drenaje con dos cuerpos adentro, una punta de un dedo de un guante de látex encontrada en la escena del crimen apuntaría a los investigadores hacia el asesino.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Avis Banks y su hijo no nacido fueron brutalmente asesinados. El cuerpo fue descubierto por su prometido Keyon Pittman. La policía se enteró de que Pittman estaba teniendo aventuras con otras mujeres y se convirtió en el principal sospechoso.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: No había una razón clara para que un joven y saludable estudiante universitario estuviera muerto. Pero cuando el forense descubrió una pequeña pista durante la autopsia, los investigadores pudieron descubrir un misterio lleno de traición y venganza.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un rastro de un asesinato se esfuma, hasta que la policía recibe un llamado de una mujer cuyo esposo, Gerald Powers, tenía un pasado criminal y una afición por los Chevy Berettas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Se denuncia la desaparición de una mujer tras una pelea con su marido. La policía sospecha de un hombre que denunció un incendio en su automóvil. En el interior se encuentran dos diminutas gotas de sangre.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Se descubrió un esqueleto humano en las marismas de Carolina del Norte y, cuando los investigadores descubrieron que había estado muerta durante 18 meses, sabían que sería difícil descubrir quién era, y mucho más quién la mató.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando un rico magnate inmobiliario desapareció, pareció ser un juego sucio. En su testamento, dejó instrucciones sobre lo que sucedería si moría en circunstancias violentas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Durante siete años, un trío de hombres robó un banco tras otro. Siempre se escapaban antes de que llegara la policía y no dejaban pruebas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Camino fatal
programme.desc: Un patrullero de carreteras fue enviado a lo que pensó que sería un accidente de tráfico de rutina hasta que miró en el automóvil.

programme.desc: Lisa Manderach y su hija Devon dejaron su casa para ir de compras, pero no regresaron a la hora que se esperaba. El esposo de Lisa, Jimmy, llamó a la policía lleno de pánico para denunciar su desaparición y los dirigió a un centro comercial cercano.

Blindspots – Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: James und sein älterer Bruder Colton fahren nach Austin, Texas, um das unglaubliche Barbeque eines blinden Grillmeisters und die Live-Musik eines blinden Musikers zu genießen. Bei einem kurzer Roadtrip nach Houston treffen sie die blinde Starköchin Christine Ha, die beweist, dass im Lone Star State alles möglich ist. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Blindspots – Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: Mit seiner Schwester Cassie besucht James Frankfurt und Mainz, genießt Bier und Bratwürste – und erkundet Deutschlands Infrastruktur zur Unterstützung sehbehinderter Menschen. Der Höhepunkt ist ein Besuch im Dialogmuseum, wo die sehenden Crewmitglieder der Sendung die gesamte Ausstellung im Dunkeln erkunden müssen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Blindspots – Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: James und seine Schwester Cassie reisen in die faszinierende Stadt Zürich und besuchen die Eidgenössische Technische Hochschule Zürich, wo sie Prototypen neuer technologischer Lösungen für Barrierefreiheit ausprobieren. Außerdem wagen sie sich auf den Gipfel eines hohen Berges in Davos und verbringen dort eine Nacht in einem Iglu. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Blindspots – Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: In dieser Folge besucht der blinde Filmemacher James Rath die 24-Millionen-Metropole Tokio: Hier stellt er sich seiner Angst vor Meeresfrüchten, er entdeckt einen blinden Breakdancer und findet heraus, wie sich Sehende und Blinde in Japan, das ständig von Erdbeben bedroht ist, auf die nächste Naturkatastrophe vorbereiten. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Blindspots – Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: Der Hochgeschwindigkeitszug Shinkansen bringt James nach Osaka und seinem eigentlichen Ziel näher: dem Aufstieg auf den Fuji. Außerhalb der großen Städte sucht James in den unzähligen Tempeln von Kyoto nach Ruhe. Heilige Traditionen und ein Berg voller Affen bieten ihm eine neue Perspektive auf das Leben. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Faszination Rollenspiel
programme.desc: Kanonendonner am Rhein. In der Stadt Zons warten Männer mit Schwertern und Langwaffen auf die historische Schlacht. Über 500 Jahre nach den tatsächlichen Ereignissen des Neusser Krieges inszenieren hunderte europäische Spätmittelalter-Darsteller den Sturm auf die Stadtmauern von 1475 neu. Denn Rollenspiele und Geschichte zum Anfassen boomen nach wie vor. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Faszination Rollenspiel
programme.desc: Wovon viele Menschen Albträume bekommen, bringt sie erst so richtig in Stimmung: Tausende von Liebhabern des Horrorfilms schlüpfen selbst gern in die Rolle von Monstern, Psychopathen oder Zombies. Auf Conventions und Szene-Treffen leben sie in selbstdesignten und professionellen Kostümen ihren Spaß am Schrecken aus. Curiosity begleitet die "Frightguys.

programme.title: Buddhas Kämpfer
programme.desc: In einem Wald bei Kaiserslautern liegt das einzige Shaolin-Kloster Europas, das Kampfmönche ausbildet. Novizen und Meister trainieren hier bis zu acht Stunden am Tag. Es geht um körperliche Grenzerfahrungen und die Befreiung des Geistes. Wer sich einmal mit den Mönchen messen möchte, kann eine Woche "Kloster auf Zeit" buchen. Bewerber gibt es viele, mithalten können nur wenige. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Schicksalstor Europa
programme.desc: Der Flüchtlingsstrom reißt nicht ab. Über Balkanroute, Mittelmeer und Ärmelkanal versuchen Menschen, aus Krisenregionen in Afrika und im Nahen Osten nach Europa zu kommen. Der Krieg in der Ukraine hat zusätzlich Millionen in die Flucht getrieben.

programme.title: Rückkehr zum Mond
programme.desc: Private Unternehmen und staatliche Raumfahrtprogramme wetteifern darum, Raketen und Maschinen zu entwickeln, die uns zurück auf den Mond bringen. Manche wollen im Mondboden ungeahnte Reichtümer finden, andere wollen Technologien erproben, die eines Tages für den Aufbau einer Kolonie auf dem Mars genutzt werden könnten. Doch kosmische Strahlung, Mondbeben und Meteoriten stellen große Gefahren dar.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Wie können wir uns den Wind als mächtige Naturgewalt möglichst effizient zunutze machen? Einer der größten Windparks der Welt entsteht vor der englischen Küste, wo die rauen Bedingungen das Projekt vor große Herausforderungen stellen. Unterdessen strebt ein norwegisches Team danach, den allerersten schwimmenden Windpark zu bauen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Es ist die größte technologische Herausforderung, der sich die Menschheit je gestellt hat: die Kernfusion. Sie könnte das Streben nach der ultimativen Energielösung ein für alle Mal beenden. Doch die Herausforderungen sind so gewaltig, dass ein stromerzeugender Fusionsreaktor bisher schwer fassbar und unerreichbar erschien – bis jetzt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Auf den Straßen nimmt die Anzahl der Autos mit Elektromotor stetig zu, aber für die Luftfahrt gilt der Verzicht auf fossile Brennstoffe noch als visionär. Das deutsche Unternehmen Volocopter entwickelt elektrisch angetriebene Hubschrauber.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Wenn die globale Schifffahrt ein Land wäre, wäre sie der sechstgrößte Verursacher von Treibhausgasemissionen. Aber Reedereien und Ingenieure schaffen bemerkenswerte neue Maschinen, um ihre Industrie umweltfreundlicher zu machen. Dafür nutzen sie eine Ressource, die den Menschen seit Jahrtausenden über die Weltmeere bewegt: Wind. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Die Klimaretter
programme.desc: Mangroven sind wahre Wunderbäume, denn sie wachsen dort, wo die Bedingungen für andere Pflanzen tödlich sind: verankert im Salzwasser der heißen Küstenregionen. Doch ihre Bestände werden oft für illegale Bauprojekte abgeholzt. Das hat dramatische Folgen für die Umwelt. In Deutschland ruft die Bewegung Extinction Rebellion auf den Plan mit spektakulären Aktionen zur Rettung der Erde. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Schwimmen gegen Plastikmüll
programme.desc: Den Rhein und den Tennessee River hat er schon durchkrault, jetzt nimmt sich Chemieprofessor Andreas Fath die Donau vor. 2700 km flussabwärts, vom Schwarzwald bis zum Schwarzen Meer. Am Ufer klären Naturschützer über Plastikmüll auf.

Außerdem wagen sie sich auf den Gipfel eines hohen Berges in Davos und verbringen dort eine Nacht in einem Iglu. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Blindspots – Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: In dieser Folge besucht der blinde Filmemacher James Rath die 24-Millionen-Metropole Tokio: Hier stellt er sich seiner Angst vor Meeresfrüchten, er entdeckt einen blinden Breakdancer und findet heraus, wie sich Sehende und Blinde in Japan, das ständig von Erdbeben bedroht ist, auf die nächste Naturkatastrophe vorbereiten. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Blindspots – Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: Der Hochgeschwindigkeitszug Shinkansen bringt James nach Osaka und seinem eigentlichen Ziel näher: dem Aufstieg auf den Fuji. Außerhalb der großen Städte sucht James in den unzähligen Tempeln von Kyoto nach Ruhe. Heilige Traditionen und ein Berg voller Affen bieten ihm eine neue Perspektive auf das Leben. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Faszination Rollenspiel
programme.desc: Kanonendonner am Rhein. In der Stadt Zons warten Männer mit Schwertern und Langwaffen auf die historische Schlacht. Über 500 Jahre nach den tatsächlichen Ereignissen des Neusser Krieges inszenieren hunderte europäische Spätmittelalter-Darsteller den Sturm auf die Stadtmauern von 1475 neu. Denn Rollenspiele und Geschichte zum Anfassen boomen nach wie vor. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Faszination Rollenspiel
programme.desc: Wovon viele Menschen Albträume bekommen, bringt sie erst so richtig in Stimmung: Tausende von Liebhabern des Horrorfilms schlüpfen selbst gern in die Rolle von Monstern, Psychopathen oder Zombies. Auf Conventions und Szene-Treffen leben sie in selbstdesignten und professionellen Kostümen ihren Spaß am Schrecken aus. Curiosity begleitet die "Frightguys.

programme.title: Buddhas Kämpfer
programme.desc: In einem Wald bei Kaiserslautern liegt das einzige Shaolin-Kloster Europas, das Kampfmönche ausbildet. Novizen und Meister trainieren hier bis zu acht Stunden am Tag. Es geht um körperliche Grenzerfahrungen und die Befreiung des Geistes. Wer sich einmal mit den Mönchen messen möchte, kann eine Woche "Kloster auf Zeit" buchen. Bewerber gibt es viele, mithalten können nur wenige. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Schicksalstor Europa
programme.desc: Der Flüchtlingsstrom reißt nicht ab. Über Balkanroute, Mittelmeer und Ärmelkanal versuchen Menschen, aus Krisenregionen in Afrika und im Nahen Osten nach Europa zu kommen. Der Krieg in der Ukraine hat zusätzlich Millionen in die Flucht getrieben.

programme.title: Titans of Defense
programme.desc: Hightech-Militärfahrzeuge sichern Nachschub und Einsatzfähigkeit im Feld: der HEMTT liefert bis zu 10 Tonnen Material in jedem Gelände, das M11450 räumt Minen mit Planierraupen und Raketen frei, der Husky MK3 nutzt Sensoren und Greifarm zur Bedrohungsbeseitigung, der M88A2 Hercules birgt Fahrzeuge und reagiert auf ABC-Gefahren und das M3 wird auch für schwerste Panzer zur Brücke. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Titans of Defense
programme.desc: Die MQ-9 Reaper ortet und trifft Ziele aus über 600 Meilen Entfernung. Die RQ-4 Global Hawk ist die größte Drohne der Welt und dient der Langstreckenaufklärung. Die DOK-ING MV4 räumt Kampfzonen von Minen. Israels Iron Dome erkennt und zerstört feindliche Raketen. Die Tomahawk Cruise Missile trifft mit hoher Präzision und Datenerfassung Ziele bis in 1.000 Meilen Entfernung. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Geniale Mega-Maschinen

Ob Monsterpressen oder imposante 3D-Drucker: Diese Gerätschaften strotzen vor Kraft und Leistung und beeindrucken dadurch schon seit Jahrzehnten. Besonders faszinierend ist die Funktionsweise einer riesigen hydraulischen Presse, die eine Kraft von 40.000 Tonnen erzeugt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Miniatur Wunderland XXL
programme.desc: Die Technik-Werkstatt im Wunderland arbeitet mit Hochdruck an der neuen Kirmes. Die Fahrgeschäfte sind alle Marke Eigenbau. Spezielle Motoren, Kugellager und Metallgetriebe sollen den Dauerbetrieb in der Anlage möglich machen. Auch das Projekt Formel 1 schreitet weiter voran, die Mini-Flitzer drehen schon die ersten Highspeed-Runden auf der Teststrecke. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Miniatur Wunderland XXL

Baukosten für die acht Quadratmeter große Spielwiese Marke Eigenbau: 750.000 Euro. Ein technisches Meisterwerk ist auch der neue Leitstand. Von hier aus wird der gesamte Verkehr im Wunderland gesteuert und überwacht. (Sen

programme.title: Miniatur Wunderland XXL
programme.desc: Das Miniatur Wunderland auf Expansionskurs. Mit einem Übergang zum gegenüberliegenden Hafenspeicher sollen 3.500 Quadratmeter Modellbaufläche erschlossen werden. Das Einsetzen der 25 Meter langen Brücke mit einem 750-Tonnen-Kran – ein Drahtseilakt! Auch im Bauabschnitt Monaco geht es voran. Die Tüftler vom Dienst wollen die Formel-1-Rennatmosphäre so realistisch wie möglich auf die Piste bringen.

programme.title: Miniatur Wunderland XXL
programme.desc: Aus Übersee kommen die ersten Modell-Elemente für die brandneue Attraktion Patagonien in Hamburg an. Der Bauabschnitt soll zu einem echten Highlight der Südamerika-Welt werden. Für die Modellbauer steht schweißtreibende Arbeit an. Die schweren Landschaften müssen auf die richtigen Positionen gestellt werden. Und der Zeitplan ist knapp: Bis zur Eröffnung bleiben nur wenige Wochen Zeit! (Senderinfo)

programme.title: Science of Thrills
programme.desc: Nicht nur das Tempo zählt, sondern auch die Länge. Diesmal besucht Rob Bell einige der längsten Achterbahnen der Welt. Wie schaffen es die Konstrukteure, die Spannung während der gesamten Fahrt aufrecht zu erhalten? Der Ingenieur und Abenteurer wirft einen Blick hinter die Kulissen der kolossalsten Adrenalinschleudern. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Science of Thrills
programme.desc: Reale Beschleunigungskräfte sind das eine – doch die rasanten Fahrgeschäfte arbeiten zum anderen auch mit psychologischen Tricks, um das Spannungsmoment weiter zu erhöhen. Rob Bell erkundet, wie uns die Ingenieure mit Hilfe unserer Wahrnehmung Streiche spielen: Kniffe, die für die Maximierung des Nervenkitzels eine Schlüsselrolle spielen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Lust auf Eis und Einsamkeit
programme.desc: Mächtige Eisberge, klirrende Kälte, dunkle Winter. Wer in Grönland leben möchte, muss das arktische Klima und die Einsamkeit mögen. Doch der arktische Norden ist für viele Auswanderer ein Sehnsuchtsziel. Was macht seine Faszination aus? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Beyond River Cottage
programme.desc: Hugh installs beehives at The River Cottage HQ, the only problem is his fear of being stung. He also takes on his biggest event yet, a wedding party, and the newlyweds want their entire menu to only include wild, or home-grown, cuisine.

programme.title: River Cottage: Summer's Here
programme.desc: Hugh wonders if slugs could make it on the River Cottage menu.

programme.title: Beyond River Cottage
programme.desc: It is party season in Dorset, and Hugh teams up with a local fisherman to catch whelks before spicing them up to sell on the beaches on Carnival Day. Back at The River Cottage HQ, Hugh is inspired to create the West Dorset Tomato Festival.

programme.title: Beyond River Cottage
programme.desc: The day has arrived for Hugh to harvest his honey, and with some help from Ken Bishop, they carefully extract a robust 25 lbs. worth of the golden sweetness. Hugh then enters some culinary delights into the Melplash Agricultural Show.

programme.title: Beyond River Cottage
programme.desc: Hugh plans a sumptuous menu for a special Autumn feast he plans to throw at The River Cottage HQ that includes a chicken feast, courtesy of Chickenopolis. It is also a good time of year to go mushroom hunting, but this time, from the air.

programme.title: Escape to River Cottage
programme.desc: Hugh arrives at River Cottage to begin his dream life away from the city sprawl and immediately sets to work preparing the land for his new vegetable garden and finding livestock. Hugh also attempts spearfishing and meets his new landlord.

programme.title: Escape to River Cottage
programme.desc: The pigs have settled in nicely to their new home, and Hugh believes it is now a good time to introduce chickens to the farm. Hugh also finds a pesky garden pest to contend with, learns the finer points of fishing, and visits a fruit farm.

programme.title: Escape to River Cottage
programme.desc: It is summer at River Cottage and the vegetables are thriving, so much so that Hugh decides to enter The Beaminster Horticultural Society's annual competition, with the Tomatillo as his secret ingredient. Hugh also fishes for spider crabs.

programme.title: River Cottage Autumn
programme.desc: Deep into the season, the harvest has been hearty for Hugh and the crew.

programme.title: Escape to River Cottage
programme.desc: Hugh discovers that mice are a formidable pest to contend with. Spurred on by this experience, he joins Jan Andrews on a hunt for deer. Hugh then strolls down memory lane with the Cheeseman family and creates a Japanese prawn tempura dish.

programme.title: Escape to River Cottage
programme.desc: It is eel migration season, and Hugh learns how to weave a unique basket trap to catch them in the river. He also joins the Chideock Cider Circle for the fall apple harvest, learns the art of cider pressing, and attends a pheasant hunt.

programme.title: Escape to River Cottage
programme.desc: Hugh has lived in River Cottage for six months, and that means his pigs have a date with butcher Ray Smith. It also means it is time for a party. Hugh also learns a remarkable technique for catching razor clams down by the seashore.

programme.title: Return to River Cottage
programme.desc: Now that he has some extra land to work with, Hugh purchases some livestock, prompting he and Angus Carmichael, a local carpenter, to build a fox-proof chicken coop. Hugh also goes scallop hunting, and enters a nettle eating competition.

programme.title: Return to River Cottage
programme.desc: Hugh's cattle and sheep are settling in, but a few of the chickens are not. Also, local vet Jeff Thomson helps with the delicate operation of castrating the calf, Hugh builds a polytunnel, and rabbits wreak havoc on the vegetables.

programme.title: Return to River Cottage
programme.desc: It is time for Hugh's landlord, Antony Hichens, to host his annual medieval fair, and Hugh decides to donate a pig for the feast. He also helps local bakers create a batch of traditional Dorset lardy cakes and learns hot to shear sheep.

programme.title: Return to River Cottage
programme.desc: Torrential late summer rains spell doom for Hugh's hay harvest, and only radical plant-surgery can save his tomatoes from blight, however the weather has helped mushrooms flourish. Hugh also enters a sheep in the Melpash Agricultural Show.

programme.title: Return to River Cottage
programme.desc: Hugh embarks to sell his entire tomato harvest at the Farmer's Market by offering a diverse range of products under the brand name: The River Cottage Glutton. Hugh also makes a bet with a rival grower as to who will sell more at market.

programme.title: River Cottage: Summer's Here
programme.desc: Hugh wonders if slugs could make it on the River Cottage menu.

programme.title: Return to River Cottage
programme.desc: With a failed hay harvest, Hugh conceives a cunning plan to supplement the winter feed he will need for his animals by throwing a party, but instead of a bottle he asks his guests to bring a bale. Hugh also agrees to an unusual request.

programme.title: River Cottage Forever
programme.desc: It is February at River Cottage, and there is precious little to eat in the pantry. But that does not stop Hugh from building "Chickenopolis." Hugh also navigates the River Brit to the sea, and receives surprising news about his sheep.

programme.title: River Cottage Forever
programme.desc: Eager to secure fishing rights to the cottage's lake, Hugh makes a wager with his landlord Antony Hichens: If Hugh can prepare a meal of carp that satisfies Antony and his guests, then Hugh shall have fishing rights to the property's lake.

programme.title: River Cottage Forever
programme.desc: It is late May, and there is bad news all around regarding the livestock, but Hugh's spirits are raised when news of cuttlefish hit his ears. At the Shaftesbury Market, Hugh ends up in a bidding war for a calf and ends up paying too much.

programme.title: River Cottage Forever
programme.desc: Hugh is determined to successfully harvest his own hay this season. He also clears his polytunnel of peas and beans in preparation for the Bridport Farmers' Market, and receives local assistance to turn his wool into fashionable garments.

programme.title: River Cottage Forever
programme.desc: Hugh summons experts to help deal with his uncooperative livestock, and soon, he feels confident in entering his saddleback, Delia, into the Okehampton Agricultural Show. Hugh also grapples with a serious aphid problem in the polytunnel.

programme.title: River Cottage Forever
programme.desc: Hugh enters his healthy vegetables into the Vegetable Challenge Cup, but first, to make some cash, he makes a batch of ice-lollies to sell to people on holiday in Dorset, and also takes Delia truffle hunting with a local mycologist.

programme.title: River Cottage Forever
programme.desc: One of Hugh's ewes has died, and two of his pigs have a date with the abattoir. However, despite all this, Hugh decides to plant roots at River Cottage, and is inspired to plant an orchard. His chickens are also nice and healthy.

programme.title: River Cottage Forever
programme.desc: As winter nears, Hugh would like to make some money at the Borough Farmers' Market, where he and Michael wind up making a small fortune. Then, after a day of bass fishing, Hugh attends a Halloween Party and partakes in Pumpkin Fettling.

programme.title: River Cottage Autumn
programme.desc: Deep into the season, the harvest has been hearty for Hugh and the crew.

programme.title: Beyond River Cottage
programme.desc: Hugh's new farm is 10 times the size of River Cottage, so he plans to expand production, including setting up a culinary headquarters where he can sell direct to the public, but he soon wonders if he has bitten off more than he can chew.

programme.title: Beyond River Cottage
programme.desc: Several weeks after Hugh leased a collection of barns near his farm to serve as his culinary headquarters, he gives himself a two-week deadline to accomplish the task of getting the muck-ridden buildings up and running by Valentine's Day.

programme.title: Beyond River Cottage
programme.desc: Hugh builds a maternity room for his sow that is moments away from giving birth. He also contemplates how to install plumbing in his new headquarters, and he challenges himself to put the neglected purple broccoli back on the culinary map.

programme.title: Beyond River Cottage
programme.desc: On May Day, Hugh takes advantage of a healthy crowd that gathers on the Cerne Abbas Giant by selling his famous chocolate waffles. It is also opening night at The River Cottage HQ, and Hugh hopes to serve his guests something spectacular.

programme.desc: There are new arrivals on Hugh's farm this spring, including 11 piglets and two baby lambs. Hugh also attends an Easter Blossom Picnic Party, goes mushroom hunting for morells, and gets a crash course in breadmaking from a master baker.

Framed and hunted by bounty killer Stack, he’s wounded and taken in by the McGovern family - only to be caught in their land war against a ruthless railroad agent. As loyalties shift, Johnny’s past and fate collide.

The sage man refuses, and the Southerners massacre the tribe and abduct the young squaw anyway. The noble squaw manages to escape, and hides out with a rough rancher, who dislikes Indians, but hates the Southerners more. The odd couple joins forces, and tactics, to exert ultimate vengeance on the men at the fort.

As danger grows, Old Firehand also faces unexpected revelations about his former love and a long-hidden family secret.

programme.title: 黑道家族第1季:9
programme.desc: 東尼索波諾希望自己能兼顧兩方面,一方是身為一家之主,為了妻子,孩子們,以及喪偶的母親努力,另外一方則是經營位於紐澤西的黑道家族。工作與家庭的壓力讓索波諾身心俱疲,並產生焦慮症,他決定開始看心理醫生,這對東尼的眾多男性黑道成員來說都是相當罕見的狀況,這個秘密甚至可能惹來殺身之禍,於是他決定把此秘密埋在心底。 但究竟是什麼造成這些壓力?在家庭方面,他的婚姻搖搖欲墜,而母親則需要找一間安養中心。一名捷克黑道份子想插手介入索波諾的廢棄物管理事業,而東尼的姪子-血氣方剛的克立斯卻自作聰明地解決了這檔子事,他竟然殺死對方代表後棄屍在史坦登島。而煩惱的事永遠不止一樁,東尼擔心黑道家族的黃金歲月已經逝去,他深怕自己無法與過去的黑幫英雄人物相比擬。請千萬別錯過這部精采影集,一起探訪這異於常人的黑道家族與龍頭老大東尼索波諾的故事。

programme.title: Last Week Tonight with John Oliver
programme.desc: British comic and political satirist John Oliver discusses a number of the news, political and current events stories that have been featured during the week, providing his own witty and sardonic take

programme.title: 龍族前傳第3季:2
programme.desc: 《龍族前傳》改編自喬治馬汀（George Martin）所撰寫的《冰與火之歌前傳：血火同源》（Fire & Blood）小說，描述《冰與火之歌：權力遊戲》兩百年前的維斯特洛大陸，「龍家」坦格利安家族的故事

programme.title: 鍍金年代第3季:7
programme.desc: 年輕的瑪麗安布魯克從賓州鄉下搬到紐約繼承大量遺產的姑姑家，並不經意地被捲入了姑姑與富豪鄰居的鍍金年代社交爭鬥中

programme.title: 我家也有大明星第3季:17
programme.desc: 在上一季中拍攝過程波折不斷的《水行俠》終於順利殺青，並且即將舉行盛大首映。隨著首映會日期的逼近，全體工作人員以及死黨們都在為了文斯電影生涯中這件最隆重的事情做足準備

programme.title: 好球天團第3季:9
programme.desc: 這齣HBO原創影集的第三季描寫前美式足球巨星改頭換面在邁阿密擔任現役球員的財務經理

programme.title: 殺手進城第1季:6
programme.desc: 這齣HBO原創喜劇描寫廉價殺手巴里想要開啟身為演員的新的人生，然而過往的犯罪經歷卻緊抓著他不放…

programme.title: 黑道家族第1季:9
programme.desc: 東尼索波諾希望自己能兼顧兩方面,一方是身為一家之主,為了妻子,孩子們,以及喪偶的母親努力,另外一方則是經營位於紐澤西的黑道家族。工作與家庭的壓力讓索波諾身心俱疲,並產生焦慮症,他決定開始看心理醫生,這對東尼的眾多男性黑道成員來說都是相當罕見的狀況,這個秘密甚至可能惹來殺身之禍,於是他決定把此秘密埋在心底。 但究竟是什麼造成這些壓力?在家庭方面,他的婚姻搖搖欲墜,而母親則需要找一間安養中心。一名捷克黑道份子想插手介入索波諾的廢棄物管理事業,而東尼的姪子-血氣方剛的克立斯卻自作聰明地解決了這檔子事,他竟然殺死對方代表後棄屍在史坦登島。而煩惱的事永遠不止一樁,東尼擔心黑道家族的黃金歲月已經逝去,他深怕自己無法與過去的黑幫英雄人物相比擬。請千萬別錯過這部精采影集,一起探訪這異於常人的黑道家族與龍頭老大東尼索波諾的故事。

programme.title: 無間警探-闇夜國度第4季:1
programme.desc: 描述漫長的冬夜降臨時，Tsalal 極地研究站的八名男子竟離奇地消失得無影無蹤。為了破案，警探 Liz Danvers和 Evangeline Navarro只能勇敢面對他們所背負的黑暗過往，試圖挖掘出埋藏於永凍冰層底下的鬧鬼真相。

programme.title: 噬血真愛第7季:8

programme.title: 竊盜警長第1季:2

programme.title: 生活科技大解密第14季:5
programme.desc: 生活科技大解密第14季:第5集.皇家恩菲爾德機車公司的大陸GT是英國經典車款，現今在印度塔米爾納杜邦的欽奈再造成21世紀的新風貌。由於印度陸軍大量訂購此車款，英國廠商索性在當地設廠，製造堅固耐用的車架、焊接外殼、安裝引擎、並裝配組件。比利時布魯塞爾的古董神探能利用熱能螢光定年法來判定是否為贗品，藉由輻射來鑑定陶器年份。現今生產牛奶的流程採全自動化，將飼料放入機器內的桶子後，母牛會受食慾驅使而上前，自動吸杯就定位後即可開始擠奶。送到乳品工廠後再製作全脂和半脂牛奶，並確認成品是否無菌安全。

programme.title: 生活科技大解密第14季:6
programme.desc: 生活科技大解密第14季:第6集.高速公路安全保險研究所為提升汽車安全，會對車款做撞擊測試。先仔細檢查車輛，並用座標儀記錄所有結構端點，以高速攝影機拍攝撞擊，撞擊後檢查各個座標，並檢視假人身上感應器傳回的資料。荷蘭的德夫特以產青花瓷聞名，先將中國瓷粉混成漿倒入模，乾燥後噴上釉底料，窯燒第一次，再用氧化鈷顏料繪上花紋，進窯用高溫燒第二次。五折傘會先組合金屬傘架與可多段折合的傘骨，縫合尼龍傘罩，套上傘骨和把手即大功告成。

programme.desc: 理查哈蒙玩很大:巨無霸船隻.理查哈蒙玩很大，這次要玩的是一艘超級貨櫃船，瑪莉馬士基號是世上數一數二的大船，運送幾十億美元的貨物到幾千公里外的地方，它運送的貨品，你可能坐過、看過或穿過。除了上船體驗實際運作情形，理查還跟隨瑪莉馬士基號來到歐洲最大港，鹿特丹，順便體驗自動化港口的未來科技。

programme.title: 生活科技大解密第14季:5
programme.desc: 生活科技大解密第14季:第5集.皇家恩菲爾德機車公司的大陸GT是英國經典車款，現今在印度塔米爾納杜邦的欽奈再造成21世紀的新風貌。由於印度陸軍大量訂購此車款，英國廠商索性在當地設廠，製造堅固耐用的車架、焊接外殼、安裝引擎、並裝配組件。比利時布魯塞爾的古董神探能利用熱能螢光定年法來判定是否為贗品，藉由輻射來鑑定陶器年份。現今生產牛奶的流程採全自動化，將飼料放入機器內的桶子後，母牛會受食慾驅使而上前，自動吸杯就定位後即可開始擠奶。送到乳品工廠後再製作全脂和半脂牛奶，並確認成品是否無菌安全。

programme.title: 生活科技大解密第14季:6
programme.desc: 生活科技大解密第14季:第6集.高速公路安全保險研究所為提升汽車安全，會對車款做撞擊測試。先仔細檢查車輛，並用座標儀記錄所有結構端點，以高速攝影機拍攝撞擊，撞擊後檢查各個座標，並檢視假人身上感應器傳回的資料。荷蘭的德夫特以產青花瓷聞名，先將中國瓷粉混成漿倒入模，乾燥後噴上釉底料，窯燒第一次，再用氧化鈷顏料繪上花紋，進窯用高溫燒第二次。五折傘會先組合金屬傘架與可多段折合的傘骨，縫合尼龍傘罩，套上傘骨和把手即大功告成。

programme.title: 決戰軍武 第1季第3集
programme.desc: 本集介紹介紹鎧甲和裝甲。在1970年代, 杜邦公司的科學家開發了克維拉纖維, 就相同重量來說, 比鋼的強度高五倍。從1990年代開始, 偽裝開始有了數位化的特徵, 設計師還要處理稱為條件等色的現象。狙擊手往往要跟蹤目標好幾天, 為了避免被發現, 他們依靠一種獨特的偽裝稱作吉利服。艾布蘭M1坦克是有史以來最致命, 保護裝置最佳的坦克。蘇聯的工程師開發的T-34坦克, 在幾何形狀上採用斜面設計。到了1940年, 德國工程師開發出錐形裝藥的高爆反坦克彈頭。在1960年代, 英國喬伯姆研究中心的研究人員開發出喬伯姆裝甲, 那種新材料是堅硬的陶瓷化合物。艾布蘭坦克設計師添加了一層保護層, 也就是耗竭鈾。黏著榴彈使用衝擊波, 並不會穿透坦克的裝甲, 而是將坦克裝甲震碎變成武器。威斯康辛州奧什科什的奧什科什防禦中心, 推出的裝甲車稱為防地雷反伏擊運兵車。克維拉織網是對抗火箭推進榴彈的解決方案。爆炸成形穿

programme.desc: 亞特蘭提斯城是史上最著名的失落之城, 古城遺跡從地表上消失無蹤, 偉大帝國的整個文明在一夕之間化為烏有, 自古以來已有無數探險家走遍世界各地尋找蛛絲馬跡, 但都一無所獲。考古學家安德魯高夫多年來一直在尋找亞特蘭提斯城, 他取得一套嶄新的電腦程式, 可以先依據柏拉圖著作中敘述的有關亞特蘭提斯所在地的５１個提示, 經過比對篩選, 挑出最符合柏拉圖提示的地區, 再實地去進行各種地質和地理環境的勘查, 看是否能找出亞特蘭提斯城的確切遺址, 在這趟尋覓的過程中, 他先從同樣是海島的桑托里尼島開始探索起, 那裡曾有強盛的邁諾安文明, 因為猛烈的火山噴發而使偉大文明也在驟然之間灰飛煙滅, 但是柏拉圖的敘述中卻隻字未提火山, 所以桑托里尼島應該就不可能是亞特蘭提斯, 接著他又認為可能是在希臘的克里特島, 那兒也曾經因為海嘯肇禍而毀於一旦, 但是海嘯並未讓克里特島的邁諾安人就此滅亡, 所以也不符合亞特蘭提斯

programme.title: 建築奇觀:對抗地震
programme.desc: 正在施工中的菲律賓體育館是全球最大的巨蛋建築, 完工後將成為全球一大建築奇觀。場館觀眾席多達5萬人, 是一般最大場館的2倍。而且觀眾席設計迥異於一般場館, 並非四面八方環繞式排列, 而是類似古希臘圓形劇場, 一端是舞台, 一端是觀眾席。這座場館從設計到施工, 都充滿挑戰。由於菲律賓處於地震帶, 場館所在地附近就是西谷斷層, 一旦移動就可能引發規模6到7的強震。因此場館施工時就納入各種防震設計。建築師還要仔細考量群眾疏散路線, 讓5萬名觀眾能安全出入。但挑戰不只如此, 建築師必須讓全球最大的圓頂屋頂能抵擋颱風吹襲, 而且相較於一般場館的30個月工期, 菲律賓體育館的施工時間只有短短24個月。包商絕對不能有任何延誤, 因為場館必須如期完工, 才能趕上業主基督堂教會的百年紀念活動!

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "From There To Here"
programme.desc: The first phase of this journey is complete, now commences the second, with robotics, advanced technologies and sheer daring we are now going where before we only dreamt.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "Return To The Moon"
programme.desc: Few have walked on the moon's surface, though her allure remains strong, once again we are glancing her way with renewed interest and with a view to return very soon.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "The Inner Worlds"
programme.desc: Venus the first and brightest star in the evening sky, and Mercury fleeting across the solar disk. As we begin to take a closer look at our companions they are posing more questions than answers.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "Next Stop Mars"
programme.desc: It has fired our imaginations for millennia, Mars, the God of War and the source of Man's science fictional demise. It is the only other place in our solar system than Man might one day call home.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "The Planet Makers"
programme.desc: From the beginnings of our Solar System four and half billion years ago there remains tantalizing clues to its evolution; remnent debris: asteroids and comets. Now within our grasp these rocks of ice and dust are ready to give up their secrets.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "The Ice Giants"
programme.desc: Beyond the asteroid belt lay the ice giants, some can be seen with the naked eye, others only glimpsed once by a passing probe. We are again sending cameras to the edge of the solar system giving us new insights into the evolution of our worlds.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "The Moons of Olympus"
programme.desc: These are the the Moon's of the gas giants. Each a unique and mysterious world of its own. All are worthy of much more scrutiny.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "The Sun"
programme.desc: We study our Sun closely, and like a Rosetta stone it can reveal the secrets of all the other stars above.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "Exo Planets"
programme.desc: As scientists and astronomers peer closer at nearby stars with ever more fidelity they are discovering planets; exo planets, worlds outside our own solar system.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "Edge of the Universe"
programme.desc: What we see in the night sky is only a small percentage of the contents of the Universe, most is dark matter and dark energy we know it exists; however its nature eludes us for the moment.

programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: TV Icons - Barbara Walters (11/8/83)

programme.title: The Honkers

programme.desc: In this stark, unconventional and powerful western, a ruthless rancher (Robert Ryan) must find a way to save the town of Bitters, Wyoming, its citizenry, and his own soul when a gang of outlaws rides into town. Burl Ives and Tina Louise also star.

programme.title: Man From Del Rio
programme.desc: When a Mexican gunslinger (Anthony Quinn) rids a town of several notorious gunfighters, he is named the sheriff, but must win over the rest of the residents who are yet to warm to his hard-hitting ways. Katy Jurado and Peter Whitney co-star.

programme.title: Cannon For Cordoba
