programme.title: Sabata
programme.desc: Get ready for fast-paced, explosive action as Lee Van Cleef stars as Sabata, the mysterious, steely-eyed gunslinger who, after he discovers the masterminds behind an elaborate bank heist, imposes his bullet-laced brand of justice on a guilty town.

programme.title: Adios, Sabata
programme.desc: Under the brutal rule of garrison leader Col. Skimmel, a group of Mexican revolutionaries hire gunslinger Sabata (Yul Brynner) to rob a transport of gold in order to buy weapons. But the Colonel has other plans...taking the gold for himself.

programme.title: Return Of Sabata
programme.desc: The great Lee Van Cleef ("Death Rides a Horse") returns as the famous freewheeling gunslinger Sabata. In this third and final go-round for the enigmatic sharpshooter, Sabata seeks revenge when a band of desperadoes bilks him out of $5,000.

programme.title: Duel At Diablo
programme.desc: Frontier scout Jess Remsberg leads a wagon train through hostile territory to Fort Conchos. But underneath his valor, he has an ulterior motive: to settle a score with the man he believes killed his wife. James Garner and Sidney Poitier star.

programme.title: Posse
programme.desc: Mario Van Peebles and Billy Zane shake up the frontier in this gun-blazing, fist-pounding western that takes a page missing from the history books and unfolds it with suspense, humor and awe-inspiring power! Pam Grier and Isaac Hayes co-star.

programme.title: The Long Riders
programme.desc: Jesse James and his gang ride again! David , Keith and Robert Carradine; James and Stacy Keach; Randy and Dennis Quaid; Christopher and Nicholas Guest depict real-life siblings in this charged portrayal of the Old West's legendary bandits.

programme.title: Michael Cimino's Heaven's Gate
programme.desc: This lavish, epic western retells the true story of Wyoming's infamous Johnson County War, a brutal, late 19th century conflict during which wealthy cattlemen, backed by the U.S. government, hired mercenaries to murder 125 immigrant settlers.

programme.title: Buffalo Bill and the Indians, or Sitting Bull's History Lesson
programme.desc: Buffalo Bill has fought Indians & Civil War battles, but nothing can prepare him for show business! When he signs Sitting Bull for a role in his Wild West Show, the clash of cultures reverberates far beyond the boundaries of their sprawling theater.

programme.title: Ned Kelly
programme.desc: Mick Jagger makes his dynamic screen debut in this explosive tale based on the true-life story of the 19th-century Australian "Armored Bandit," who would become a mythic sagebrush hero even as the law closes in and prepares for an all-out war.

programme.title: Man With The Gun
programme.desc: As a gang of brutal gunmen forcefully gain control of Sheridan City, its terrified citizens hire the notorious "town-tamer" Clint Tollinger to help them. But Tollinger operates in his own way...so things could get a lot worse before they get better!

programme.title: The Wonderful Country
programme.desc: In this action-packed western, ex-pat Martin Brady (Robert Mitchum) travels to Texas to broker an arms deal for Mexican Governor Castro (Pedro Armendariz). But things get complicated when the the guns he was returning to Mexico are stolen.

programme.title: Young Billy Young
programme.desc: In this gun-slinging adventure, an aging lawman (Robert Mitchum) teams up with Young Billy Young (Robert Walker), a fast-draw outlaw on the run. But it's an alliance that explodes when the lawman discovers a secret that could rip two towns apart!

programme.title: Terror In A Texas Town
programme.desc: In this compelling and imaginative western, a peace-loving Swedish seaman is forced to take on an entire frontier town when he discovers a ruthless oil prospector has been forcing farmers to sell their land...or pay for it with their lives.

programme.title: Cast A Long Shadow
programme.desc: Audie Murphy plays a troubled saddle tramp with a penchant for drinking. After inheriting a ranch, he is led back into the arms of an old flame.

programme.title: From Noon Till Three

programme.desc: In this hilarious western spoof, insurance broker Milford Farnsworth (Bob Hope) unwittingly sells a life insurance policy worth $100,000 to the infamous Jesse James. Now, he has to figure out how to keep the deadliest outlaw in history alive!

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP
programme.desc: Esteban busca hacer un trío y Aylin busca exclusividad. Llega un nuevo EX y hace que Frida respire de nuevo. Diana esta insegura de Brandon. Kelly es mas territorial con Robbie por culpa de Michelle.

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP
programme.desc: Frida y Brandon se reencuentran y Diana toma cartas en el asunto. Kim y Suavecito se besan apasionadamente pero Ian tiene un As bajo la manga. La llegada de un nuevo Ex y alguien es expulsado.

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP
programme.desc: La Sala Tornado llama a votaciones. Algunos se van de fiesta a una casa flotante. La salida de Daphne se convierte en el pretexto para hacer explotar una bomba de tiempo que provoca una gran pelea.

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP: La manada más salvaje

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP: El tiburón tiene colmillo

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP: No soportas, ¿verdad?
programme.desc: Lalo viene a terminar los pendientes con Leslie y a Isaac le toca atacarse. Lizbeth explota contra Isaac y Rufas. Yurgenis se libera en un catamarán, sin la sombra de Brandon. El nuevo ex llega muy salsa, pero de la que no pica.

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP: El jaque mate
programme.desc: Ana saborea el plato de la venganza, mientras que Leslie se limpia las lágrimas con su orgullo. Un divertido día de playa se convierte en una pesadilla. La llegada del nuevo ex cambia el juego y La Divaza tira los dados cuando no es su turno.

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP: Veo, veo y no veo claro
programme.sub-title: Veo, veo y no veo claro

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship

programme.title: An Bord des Mclaren 570S Spider
programme.desc: Wir fahren mit dem McLaren 570S Spider ein wenig durchs Gebirge und geniessen den schönen Tag.

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing pros are carried out of the bend, we are there with the camera. Breathtaking stunts of professional drivers and slapsticks of high-powered sheet metal bullets. Spectacular scenes in which no one is harmed.

programme.title: Alfa Romeo Giulietta
programme.desc: Nowadays, the mother of all Alfa Romeo Giuliettas is a sought-after but very rare specimen among collectors. We accompany the Alfa expert and collector Hartmut Stöppel with his new Giulietta in search of the original oldtimer in the Italian region of Piedmont.

programme.title: Joseph Stalin's ZIS 110
programme.desc: James Bond still didn't have a license to kill, when this representative Russian vehicle called ZIS 110 rolled off the production line in 1949. The 110 was developed by reverse engineering a 1942 Packard Super Eight.

programme.title: Saab 93 and Saab 99 Turbo
programme.desc: In 1937 an airplane manufacturing company was founded in Sweden that later became the famous car manufacturer Saab. We present two of their iconic car models, the Saab 93 and 99 Turbo.

programme.title: Facel Vega Facellia
programme.desc: In the late 1950s, the Facel Vega Facellia was designed to compete with Porsche and Alfa Romeo and open a new market segment for the fledgling French luxury car company.

programme.title: Porsche Type 64
programme.desc: The Porsche 64 was developed in parallel with the Volkswagen Beetle by Ferdinand Porsche and his son Ferry. The streamlined racing car was designed to enter the long distance race from Berlin to Rome that never took place because of the war.

programme.title: DKW F12 Roadster
programme.desc: More than 60 years ago, the managers and workers from Ingolstadt, Germany, presented the last car manufactured under the brand name DKW, the F12 Roadster.

programme.title: Jeep Renegade
programme.desc: Jeep has been building SUVs since 1942. The Jeep Renegade comes from a traditional home. It is the youngest representative of the family and the most successful.

programme.title: Jeep Wrangler
programme.desc: In 2018 the fourth generation of the Wrangler was introduced. I contained state-of-the-art technology, but the rugged look remained the same. The brand works hard to maintain this silhouette since the very first Jeep ever, the Willys MB.

programme.title: Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10
programme.desc: The Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10 has its origins in the Japanese army. Its shape won’t win any beauty contests or achieve the best results in the wind tunnel, but this is not really the point with an SUV like this.

programme.title: Volvo Laplander 6x6
programme.desc: More extremes are always possible. Volvo's Laplander army vehicle has 6 wheels, 3 axles and provides space for at least 12 soldiers.

programme.title: Lancia Stratos HF
programme.desc: The Lancia Stratos with Ferrari power, the rally icon of the 1970s.

programme.title: Amphicar 770
programme.desc: The amphicar 770 is a unique and rare classic. It may not be the fastest car on the street, but it's always ready for getting in the water.

programme.title: Volkswagen Polo R WRC
programme.desc: For Volkswagen, the VW Polo R WRC was a means to an end in order to be allowed to compete in the World Rally Championship. For the homologation of the rally car, Volkswagen had to build the basic car in small series.

programme.title: Mercedes Concept IAA
programme.desc: The Mercedes-Benz “Concept IAA”- Intelligent Aerodynamic Automobile – is two cars in one: an aerodynamics world champion with a Cd value of 0.19 and a four-door coupé embodying irresistible design. The study, which is celebrating its world premiere at the Frankfurt International Motor Show, switches automatically from design mode to aerodynamic mode when the vehicle reaches a speed of 80 km/h.

programme.title: Rolls-Royce Wraith
programme.desc: The Rolls Royce Wraith is different. It gives the traditional British brand a whole new dynamic.

programme.title: Rolls-Royce Dawn Convertible
programme.desc: Almost silently, it glides through the night. In front of the driver 12 smoothly-running cylinders are at work, with a power reserve that seems inexhaustible. The Rolls Royce Dawn is a convertible for connoisseurs.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: The RCN Challenge is the ultimate BMW driving experience. We also paid a visit to the Devils Diner, the track's indoor meeting place for drivers.

programme.title: Bentley Mulsanne EWB

programme.title: Bentley Bentayga
programme.desc: With the Bentley Bentayga, the traditional British brand is entering the fastest growing market segment. This world's first luxury SUV is a conglomerate of superlatives on wheels.

programme.title: Motorvision TV

programme.title: Trackmasters

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: The roaring sounds of engines and exhausts usually dominate the Nürburgring, but we focused on something a bit quieter this time. How about taking part in a 15 mile bike ride around the ring, or perhaps a 16 mile run?

programme.desc: From 2006 to 2012 the German company Artega produced their GT sports car model. Thanks to the know-how of a former Porsche and BMW manager the Artega GT was able to be manufactured in a small series.

programme.desc: Luxury, lifestyle and exclusivity, no other cars transport these attributes better than the SUVs by Jaguar, Range Rover, Bentley, Volvo and Infinity. These stylish and excellently equipped SUVs embody a spirit of adventure and a zest for life.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: US SUVs and pickup trucks like the Cadillac Escalade, Chevrolet Tahoe, Ford Raptor or Dodge Ram are large, powerful and luxurious and exude the feeling of unlimited possibilities and adventure.

programme.sub-title: Porsche Outlaw Magnus Walker - Los Angeles

programme.title: Ford GT40

programme.title: Supercars

programme.title: 紅毯先生
programme.desc: 聰穎40年的大明星, 又一次與金像獎失之交臂。而此刻他卻在辦公室裡拍攝起自己經典形象的懷舊短視頻。面對鏡頭, 說著老鐵 666, 他覺得太 low 了。他覺得不應該嘩眾取寵, 消費自己, 應該去拍一部電影。於是他找到自己曾經扶持過的內地導演, 主演一部農村題材的電影, 贏回失去的獎盃。他習慣於當個電影明星, 在日常生活裡被特殊以待。以至於他很難去把自己和那些社會地位低於他的路人甚至農民聯繫起來。而他與女性之間, 也存在著無法逾越的鴻溝。為了新角色的成功, 他需要去向村民們學習他們真實的生活和說話方式。但村民們最終還是看穿了他以及他所屬階層的傲慢以及虛榮心。可如果一個大明星都學不會溝通, 那他也只是一個無名小卒罷了。但假設他不能拋棄虛榮心和偏見, 他就無法溝通。如果他做到了, 他們會再給他一次機會嗎?

programme.title: 小Q
programme.desc: 小Q自出娘胎便帶著與別不同的胎記在Dr. Lo家出生, 未幾交給陳生陳太和女兒芷喬一家三口帶養, 感情深厚。長大後由導盲犬訓練員Simon悉心訓練, 帶到名廚李寶庭家中配對, 寶庭因失明導致脾氣暴躁, 不單喝罵辭去教職替他打理甜品店的妹妹寶兒, 更三番四次趕走小Q, 但受過嚴格導盲訓練的小Q依然不離不棄, 任何情況下也以身護主, 忠誠終於解開寶庭心結, 促使他勇於開闊新生活, 不以失明停步, 繼續鑽研新甜品, 一人一狗並浪蕩天涯!然而隨著小Q年紀漸大, 寶庭急病, 一人一狗如何面對無可避免的分離......

programme.title: 爆谷製造
programme.desc: 香港年度特技災難鉅製《焚城》, 雲集跨代演員, 飾演政府官員的莫文蔚、王菀之首次合作便已一見如故, 更分享演繹角色的挑戰之處, 《焚城》由兩屆金像獎最佳攝影潘耀明執導, 江志強監製及出品, 二人大談拍攝過程的困難及複雜的後期製作, 力求將逼真的災難世界呈現於觀眾眼前。

programme.title: 爆谷巨星匯：謝君豪: 焚城 (加長版)
programme.desc: 一場意外引發輻射洩漏, 全港命運危在旦夕。為應付這場毀滅性災難, 專家范偉立加入由署理行政長官Cecilia主持的緊急危機應變小組。700萬人家園隨時毀於一旦, 消防隊臨危受命深入輻射區, 拼死阻止輻射擴散全港。面對前所未見的末日浩劫, 香港會否一夜滅城?

programme.title: 焚城的誕生
programme.desc: 《焚城》是香港首部以輻射災難為題材, 由曾獲得兩屆金像獎最佳攝影潘耀明執導, 並得到2025年第43屆香港電影金像獎5項提名。本紀錄片分別透過導演潘耀明及一眾台前幕後的工作人員的分享和經歷, 記錄和講述這部電影作品的誕生過程。

programme.title: 我的情敵女婿
programme.desc: 劏房大王梁華生為人市儈勢利, 半生女伴無數, 是個到處留情的不婚主義者, 偏偏與嘉欣在不打不相識的錯摸下, 竟產生前所未有的強烈感覺, 而對她展開熱烈的追求。其時嘉欣剛與負心男友分手, 正接受當心理醫生的繼母所安排的特別心理治療, 而在「重生」療程中, 她與華生接連相遇, 由鬥氣冤家, 到漸生好感, 終於在華生的接連感動下, 二人不只發生戀情, 甚至決定結婚。嘉欣把華生帶回家中, 華生赫然發現嘉欣的繼母, 竟然是自己的初戀情人鍾嘉寶, 二人事隔多年再次重逢, 彷如隔世, 但礙於身份的尷尬, 彼此卻不相認。嘉欣和華生的婚期日漸迫近, 嘉寶和華生過去的種種感覺竟日漸湧現, 一個曲折離奇, 而耐人尋味的跨代戀情, 現在才正式開始...

programme.title: 錯在新宿
programme.desc: 小男人阿寬與妻Ann復合後, 互相遷就, 再婚生活逐漸愜意。寬進公關公司任職, 認識了缺乏自信的女同事關之琳。見她終日冒冒失失, 更被追求不遂者捉挾, 寬於心不忍, 在工作上處處扶持。正因如此, 關對寬由同事之誼轉為男女之情, 剛好寬與Ann稍有磨擦, 寬轉而愛上了關, 更與關去日本公幹。此時, Ann遇上區議員朱君, 對朱頗有好感, 但Ann懸崖勒馬, 沒有動真情。返港後, 寬欲向Ann攤牌, 關竟搶著表示與寬只屬工作關係, 請Ann放心。關毅然斷絕與寬的感情關係, 令寬遭受打擊, 心情頹然。Ann得悉真相, 與寬決裂, 幾經糾纏、掙扎、衝突, 兩人竟又復合, 展開了另一段再婚又再婚的新婚生活。

programme.title: 風雲雄霸天下
programme.desc: 天下會幫主雄霸欲得天下, 請神算泥菩薩批算, 泥菩薩預言他的前半生: 「金鱗豈是池中物, 一遇風雲便化龍。」於是雄霸下令找兩名孩童收為徒弟, 他們生辰八字要與批示相符, 以助雄霸大業。他們就是聶風和步驚雲, 但實際上二人都與雄霸有不共戴天之仇...

programme.title: 陰陽錯
programme.desc: 保險公司調查主任古志明被派調查一宗個案的死因, 而死者竟是他們所請的「碟仙」張小瑜。 好奇心驅使下, 古積極進行調查。某夜, 瑜的鬼魂突出現於古的居室, 她的甜美樣子, 幽默活潑的性格引起古的愛慕, 古不惜一切放棄未婚妻 Ivy, 與瑜開始一段人鬼奇妙的戀情。畢竟人鬼殊途, 陰陽異極終不能相結合, 最後只能留下甜蜜深刻的回憶...

programme.title: Rassemblance

programme.title: Sexugénaires

programme.title: Trentenaires

programme.title: Trentenaires
programme.desc: Les tensions entre Sophie et Vince s'accentuent ; Max et Karim commencent leur parcours avec beaucoup de nervosité ; Aless, quant à elle, réalise qu'elle est allée trop loin avec la drogue ; elle promet de se ressaisir, mais personne ne la croit.

programme.title: C dans l'air

programme.title: Vestiaires

programme.desc: Tandis que Guilhem regrette le comportement qu'il a eu envers Bertier par le passé, le père de Thaïs est placé en garde à vue. Est-ce lui l'assassin de Damien ?

programme.title: Le match dans le match
programme.desc: Douze fois champion du monde de jet-ski, Cyrille Lemoine revient sur son parcours exceptionnel, de ses débuts en motocross à sa transition suite à une blessure.

programme.title: Pistes vertes
programme.desc: Dans le pays d'Auge, Marion accueille des visiteurs dans sa maison, où sont présents des dizaines d'animaux domestiques. Cean met en place des ruches pour protéger les abeilles.

programme.title: Nus et culottés
programme.desc: Toujours nus et sans argent Nans et Mouts partent de Saint-Raphaël sur la Côte d'Azur avec le rêve d'organiser un concert de piano au pied d'un glacier.

programme.title: Savourer
programme.desc: Pour fêter Halloween, découverte de recettes qui sauront mettre tout le monde dans l'ambiance. Peurs, mais également rires sont au programme.

programme.title: Le dessous des cartes
programme.desc: L'occasion de comprendre comment s'organise ce grand marché mondial du médicament, des sites de production aux laboratoires de recherche. Si les États-Unis conservent une place centrale dans la recherche médicale, notamment dans la lutte contre le cancer, la montée en puissance des biotechnologies chinoises est également de plus en plus visible et illustre l'émergence de nouvelles rivalités économ

programme.title: Gotha
programme.desc: À 20 ans, le prince Aymeric devient pilote automobile et prend le départ de sa première course officielle ; à la découverte de Seborga, une mystérieuse micro-principauté italienne qui revendique son indépendance ; rencontre avec l'homme qui orchestre le défilé national du 21 juillet ; focus sur le protocole royal.

programme.title: A bon entendeur
programme.desc: Tardoc : comment certains médecins gonflent la facture En janvier 2026, le système Tardoc succédait à Tarmed pour régir la facturation des prestations médicales ambulatoires. Neuf mois plus tard, ABE pose un diagnostic sans appel : le système provoque déjà des effets secondaires, comme la multiplication des rendez-vous.

programme.title: basik
programme.desc: "basik", le rendez-vous économique qui explore et explique de façon ludique l'économie, décortique notre rapport à l'argent et inspecte notre pouvoir d'achat.

programme.title: Au bout de l'enquête, la fin du crime parfait ?
programme.desc: Le 24 juillet 2009, les pompiers interviennent sur l'incendie d'une villa à Plougonvelin, dans le Finistère. Ils découvrent le corps de Jean-Jacques Le Page, un retraité de 67 ans. Les premières expertises révèlent que l'homme a été assassiné à coups de couteau. Les enquêteurs auront fort à faire pour démasquer l'auteur de ce crime.

programme.title: Tendance XXI
programme.desc: Des portraits de créateurs passionnés mettent en valeur le dynamisme de la création française. Entre mode, gastronomie et design, l'émission décrypte les tendances actuelles.

programme.title: Le match dans le match
programme.desc: A l'occasion des Masters de pétanque à Rognac, Mickaël Bonetto, triple vainqueur de cette compétition, revient sur son parcours et les défis du haut niveau.

programme.title: Maghreb-Orient Express
programme.desc: Mohamed Kaci reçoit les personnalités au coeur de l'actualité de cette partie du monde en perpétuelle ébullition. La société civile témoigne et débat en plateau des événements et des évolutions qui se produisent dans ces pays. Ce magazine est l'incontournable rendez-vous culturel en Méditerranée.

programme.title: Géopolitis
programme.desc: Pour mieux comprendre les grands enjeux internationaux, ce magazine de géopolitique décode les dessous de l'actualité politique et soulève nombre de questions.

programme.title: Objectif Monde : l'hebdo
programme.desc: Alimentée par les réseaux sociaux, la mode des animaux de compagnie exotiques dope la contrebande. Ce trafic mondial illégal engendre une terrible maltraitance animale.

programme.title: Ramdam
programme.desc: Une émission spéciale depuis Images Vevey, où la biennale fête ses 10 ans cette année et met la famille à l'honneur. Une même question traverse l'émission : comment la famille inspire-t-elle les photos et les souvenirs ?

programme.title: Vivement dimanche
programme.desc: Chanteurs, acteurs, humoristes : ce rendez-vous du dimanche met en lumière les talents d'hier, d'aujourd'hui et de demain. En première partie d'émission, Michel Drucker reçoit un invité fil rouge pour l'interroger sur son actualité et évoquer les temps forts de sa carrière.

programme.title: Un dimanche à la campagne
programme.desc: Loin du tumulte médiatique, Frédéric Lopez invite quelques célébrités le temps d'un week-end afin de leur offrir un moment hors du temps propice aux confidences. Entre émotion et fous rires, chacun se dévoile.

programme.title: Au bout de l'enquête, la fin du crime parfait ?
programme.desc: Des affaires classées, réputées insolubles, ont parfois résisté près de 50 ans à la ténacité des enquêteurs avant qu'un indice oublié, un témoignage inespéré ou une expertise scientifique innovante permette d'en confondre les coupables.

programme.title: 64' Actu
programme.desc: Rendez-vous de l'information et de la culture francophone proposé par la rédaction de TV5 Monde, "64' Le monde en français" met l'accent sur l'actualité mondiale, l'actualité francophone, culturelle, politique, économique, sociale, et sociétale ainsi que sur l'information développée par les partenaires historiques de TV5 Monde : la RTBF, la RTS, Radio Canada, Télé-Québec, France 2, France 3.

programme.title: Terriennes
programme.desc: Les activités pédagogiques visent à combattre les clichés et les idées reçues, à dénoncer le sexisme, à prendre conscience de la condition des femmes dans le monde.

programme.title: 64' Débat
programme.desc: Rendez-vous de l'information et de la culture francophone proposé par la rédaction de TV5 Monde, "64' Le monde en français" met l'accent sur l'actualité mondiale, l'actualité francophone, culturelle, politique, économique, sociale, et sociétale ainsi que sur l'information développée par les partenaires historiques de TV5 Monde : la RTBF, la RTS, Radio Canada, Télé-Québec, France 2, France 3.

programme.title: Parlons Eco
programme.desc: Le rendez-vous économique de la rédaction de TV5MONDE présenté par Vicky Bogaert. \" Parlons éco \" analyse les grandes tendances du moment et reçoit les femmes et les hommes qui entreprennent, innovent, imaginent l'économie de demain...

programme.title: Rassemblance
programme.desc: Briser les idées reçues, défaire les préjugés, quelle que soit sa culture, sa religion, sa nationalité, son orientation sexuelle, sa position sociale : incarnée par Magloire, cette série documentaire montre que l'intégration est possible, que la différence est salutaire pour le bien commun et le vivre ensemble.

programme.title: Papilles
programme.desc: A Ramatuelle, rencontre avec le chef étoilé Eric Canino, dans son restaurant La Voile et l'hôtel La Réserve. Il partage sa passion pour les produits du terroir.

programme.desc: Rencontre avec des artistes, des écrivains, des acteurs et tous ceux qui font vibrer notre époque. "L'invité" est le rendez-vous des personnalités qui font l'actualité.

programme.title: OPJ
programme.desc: Tahia Etheve, 22 ans, intègre la brigade. De son côté, le lieutenant Jackson Bellerose doit gérer une vie personnelle compliquée entre son ex-compagne enceinte et sa fiancée partie à l'autr

programme.desc: A former engineer, Pauline Katz became a professional windsurfer and is in the world's top ten. She chose to live and train in the Canaries, in Pozo Izquierdo, the Mecca of windsurfing. Not always an easy life choice.

programme.desc: 《In Case You Missed It》是由 TaiwanPlus 製作的全英文新聞精選節目，旨在為觀眾提供台灣社會的多元面貌與最新動態。每集約 15 分鐘，精選當週最具代表性與深度的報導，涵蓋文化、政治、科技、環境、性別平權、原住民議題等多樣主題。

programme.title: Taiwan Way:4
programme.desc: 讓我們隨著Chris一同踏入台灣著名的街頭宴席世界——辦桌。Chris親身見證全女性團隊的卓越表現，以嫻熟、優雅和精準的手法呈現一場宴會，團隊的高效率讓他深感驚訝。然而，辦桌不僅僅是一場美食盛宴！飲食歷史學者史蒂芬·克魯克（Steven Crook）揭示了其背後引人入勝的歷史和深意。此外，料理大師阿勇則揭開了辦桌所獨有的菜餚，以及那些不可或缺的經典美食。別錯過Chris在這段難以置信的旅程中，深入探索台灣街頭美食文化的核心！

programme.title: Guardians of Our Planet:3
programme.desc: 【守護我們的星球】是台灣第一部跨越南北極的生態電影，更是首度以台灣觀點、為地球生態發聲的紀錄片。拍攝團隊歷時 15 年，橫跨冰雪荒漠、潛入太平洋深海，遠征 115 個外景地，以克服嚴酷環境、生存繁衍的 82 個驚奇物種為敘事主角，真實呈現南北極宏偉壯麗、震懾人心的自然奇景；最後透過實際參與台灣科學家的極地研究，以台灣視角探討極地暖化與人類生存的未來，進而喚起世人守護地球環境的力量。

programme.desc: 【守護我們的星球】是台灣第一部跨越南北極的生態電影，更是首度以台灣觀點、為地球生態發聲的紀錄片。拍攝團隊歷時 15 年，橫跨冰雪荒漠、潛入太平洋深海，遠征 115 個外景地，以克服嚴酷環境、生存繁衍的 82 個驚奇物種為敘事主角，真實呈現南北極宏偉壯麗、震懾人心的自然奇景；最後透過實際參與台灣科學家的極地研究，以台灣視角探討極地暖化與人類生存的未來，進而喚起世人守護地球環境的力量。

programme.title: The Executioner
programme.desc: 1970. Thriller. Directed by Sam Wanamaker. Stars George Peppard, Joan Collins & Judy Geeson. A British agent is determined to prove that a respected colleague is really a Soviet spy.

programme.title: Legend of the Hidden City
programme.desc: 1997. Stars Brendan Pollecutt, Fezile Mpela & Robert Finlayson. Kabeth and Ammon get help to get hold of the scrolls; Morgan prepares his men to break into the prison and Ram captures Dean.

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Young Widow. 1959. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. Having escaped from Gessler's troops, Tell and his wife are given refuge by the beautiful Countess von Marheim. [S]

programme.title: Hawkeye & the Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Winter Passage. 1957. Directed by Sam Newfield. Stars John Hart, Lon Chaney Jr.& Kay Hawtrey. Frontier wives hope to join their husbands in time for Christmas. [S]

programme.title: The Lone Ranger
programme.desc: Lone Ranger Triumphs. 1949. Stars Jay Silverheels, Clayton Moore & John Hart. The Lone Ranger still on the trail of Butch Cavendish and his gang sends Tonto to the town of Colby. [S]

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: Flight of Fancy. 1961. Stars David Graham & Graydon Gould. Jimmy falls asleep reading about the missing princess of Barania. He wakes and steals Supercar to launch a dangerous rescue operation. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Borrowed Baby. 1957. Stars Richard Greene, Bernadette O'Farrell & Sylvia Kay. The Sheriff plots to arrest Maid Marian for assisting Robin and the outlaws, using a borrowed baby as bait. [S]

programme.title: Attack from Space
programme.desc: 1965. Sci-fi. Directed by Koreyoshi Akasaka, Teruo Ishii & Akira Mitsuwa. Stars Ken Utsui & Sachihiro Ohsawa. The rulers of planet Emerald send superhero Starman to protect Earth from evil aliens. [S]

programme.title: I'm All Right Jack
programme.desc: 1959. Comedy. Director: John Boulting. Stars Peter Sellers, Terry-Thomas & Ian Carmichael. After leaving the army, upper class Windrush takes a job in industry. He then accidently starts a strike. [S]

programme.title: Scales of Justice
programme.desc: 1963. Undesirable Neighbour. Stars Vanda Godsell & Bridget Armstrong. Based on a real case, a newly married woman becomes very friendly with her male neighbours. [S] (S1, E05)

programme.title: This Happy Breed
programme.desc: 1944. Drama. Director: David Lean. Stars Robert Newton, Celia Johnson, John Mills & Stanley Holloway. After WW1, a family lead an ordinary sort of life until the outbreak of WW2. [S]

programme.title: Dick Turpin
programme.desc: Sentence of Death: Part 1. 1982. Stars Richard O'Sullivan & Alfie Bass. After spending years imprisoned in Jamaica, Barnaby Husk seeks revenge. Isaac Rag takes King George's cousin under his wing. [S]

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: Inspector Lognon's Triumph. 1961. Stars Rupert Davies, Neville Jason & Henry Oscar. Maigret works on a case with his old rival, the constantly miserable Inspector Lognon. [S]

programme.title: Lillie
programme.desc: Emilie. 1978. Stars Francesca Annis, Anton Rodgers, Patrick Holt. On Jersey, young Emelie Charlotte Le Breton grows up as one of the boys, but her mother takes her to London to show her a Season. [S]

programme.title: Our Man Flint
programme.desc: 1966. Comedy. Directed by Daniel Mann. Stars James Coburn, Lee Cobb & Gila Golan. Top agent Derek Flint is called in to investigate why the world is being affected by extreme, violent weather. [S]

programme.title: EuroTrash
programme.desc: 1998. Hosted by Antoine de Caunes. Tonight, Lolo shows us her bicycle pumps, there's a backstage look at the reigning queen of finish fitness and take an onstage dive with some naked Austrians.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Raves
programme.desc: 2001. Stars Vernon Kay, Paul Eastwood & Glenn Ward. Following a group of young people around America as they go to various raves, nightclubs, events and other parties.

programme.title: The Murder Mansion
programme.desc: 1972. Horror. A young couple become lost and refuge in an old mansion. During the night they are drawn into a web of ghostly apparitions, legends of witchcraft and a series of supernatural deaths. [S]

programme.title: Cactus Flower
programme.desc: 1969. Comedy. Directed by Gene Saks. Stars Walter Matthau, Ingrid Bergman & Goldie Hawn. A dentist convinces his assistant to pose as his wife so he can avoid marrying his girlfriend. [S]

programme.title: The Brigitte Bardot Story
programme.desc: French actress and singer Brigitte Bardot rose to fame with films that challenged conservative norms. This documentary tells the story of her becoming an international icon and sex symbol. [S]

programme.title: Calling All Cars
programme.desc: 1954. Starring Cardew Robinson, Adrienne Fancey, John Fitzgerald and Pauline Olsen. Comedy documentary, centring on the Dover Harbour car terminal. Directed by Maclean Rogers. [S]

programme.title: One Step Beyond
programme.desc: The Open Window. 1959. Stars Michael Higgins, Louise Fletcher & Charles Seel. A temperamental artist has a premonition of a woman's death in a neighbouring building. [S]

programme.title: Design for Loving

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Norma y Jimena llegan a la hacienda y se enteran de la traición de Eva, Fernando y Sara quieren denunciarla a ella y a los Reyes, mientras Gabriela retiene a sus hijas para protegerlas.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Se arma una fuerte pelea cuando los Reyes llegan a la hacienda para hablar con Norma y Jimena. Eva se va de la hacienda por orden de Fernando y Raquel le prohíbe que se acerque a su hija Ruth.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Armando ordena un ataque contra los hermanos Reyes, Franco encuentra una oportunidad para revertir la desgracia de su familia después de perder a Rosario. Norma se empeña en olvidar a Juan.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Franco firma los documentos que lo acreditan como el propietario de la fortuna de Eduvina Trueba, aunque Juan persuade a su hermano para evitar que arruine su vida con una mujer mayor que él.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Eduvina no sigue las órdenes de su médico, Franco tampoco calma su euforia y las consecuencias son inevitables. Juan y Óscar quieren irse del pueblo, imaginan a su hermano en una luna de miel.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Malcolm y Carmela humillan a Franco y acusan a Eva de ladrona, ella se entera de que Reyes es dueño de la hacienda y busca a sus hermanos. Juan obliga al viudo de Eduvina a poner todo en su sitio.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Franco le pide ayuda a Juan y a Óscar, su hermano mayor se niega hasta que Eva lo convence para que acepte. Jimena consigue trabajo, Fernando llega con Pepita a la hacienda Elizondo.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Los Reyes asumen sus responsabilidades en la hacienda, pasan los meses y Norma da a luz a su bebé, Jimena tiene éxito en su trabajo aunque extraña a Óscar, él no aguanta los celos al verla.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Juan acepta la decisión de su hermano porque es la oportunidad para acercarse a Norma, ella se preocupa cuando ve a Fernando con su bebé. Jimena le muestra a Ruth unas fotos de Libia.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Sarita se encuentra con el nuevo dueño de la hacienda Trueba, con quien tiene una fuerte discusión, ella cae del caballo y se desmaya, cuando despierta está en la habitación de Franco.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Sarita y Franco pelean de nuevo, esta vez delante de todos los invitados a la fiesta en honor a los Reyes. Juan muere de celos al ver a Fernando con Gabriela, teme que Norma haya vuelto con él.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Juan conoce a su hijo y lo toma en sus brazos con ternura, Gabriela arma un escándalo hasta que Norma aclara que él tiene derechos porque es el padre, luego ella desacata la orden de su madre.

The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.desc: Learn how to interview potential doctors, which tests you need and how to make the most of your next doctor’s visit. Plus, when you need to go to the emergency room – STAT.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Why Do I Itch and Smell Like That?
programme.desc: Get the lowdown on bug, mosquito and spider bites, tickles in the back of your throat and more! And, why bad breath may indicate a more serious problem. Plus, see the latest at-home technology to relieve itchy skin.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: A breakthrough eye surgery allows a legally blind man to see again. And, Brian Littrell of The Backstreet Boys opens up about his 6-year-old son's fight with Kawasaki Disease. Learn how to spot the warning signs in your child.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: THE DOCTORS tests an app that promises to measure just how ugly you are and the results aren’t pretty! Find out why a hospital billed a couple for holding their newborn! In a THE DOCTORS exclusive, Olivia Newton-John’s daughter, Chloe Lattanzi, reveals the truth behind the plastic surgery rumors! Then, baseball legend Darryl Strawberry discusses his battle with addiction and his attempt to reach out to NBA star Lamar Odom! Plus, the hidden dangers of Halloween make-up

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Caught on tape: a public meltdown at the gym! What to do when someone flies off the handle in public! Then, a 90-pound weight loss without surgery? Hear one woman’s personal tips that helped her get trim! And, The voice of beloved cartoon characters like Bugs Bunny, Ren and Stimpy, Doug and Futurama reveals his story of overcoming prostate cancer! The risk factors all men need to know! Plus, legendary Latin King of Comedy Paul Rodriguez opens up about his sister’s tragic diabetic death. Hear his heartache and his desire to improve his own personal health. Then, if you’re one of the 42 million Americans struggling with constipation, proctologist Dr. David Rosenfeld shares his top foods that can help you poop! Plus, a sweet trick for a bug-free BBQ!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Which side of the family tree is to blame for balding? One of America's most famous bald men, Dr. Phil, makes a surprise appearance to help settle the argument once and for all. And, the hairiest manscaping project yet!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Jersey Shore star undergoes 6-pack surgery! Housewives on drug-spiked cheese? The benefits of cow cuddling? DIY facial! Are women happier with younger men? Autistic man’s amazing weight loss. New fitness trend: crawling emotional support alligator. The fruit you need to eat!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Massive skin removal reveal post weight loss! Break up battle plan with Dr. Ish. Does beer make men more fertile? “Morgue Mom” Mysteries! The ABC’s of cancer and what you need to know today! Viral superstar “Sancho” the therapy dog! Fridge hacks you must have!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: An alarming number of children are developing food allergies. Is your child one of them? Learn how to recognize symptoms and what treatments can keep your child safe. Is the fastest way to lose weight … eating more cookies? See if the controversial Cookie Diet is right for you! Find out what every woman needs to know about menopause, including the latest treatments to make the transition easier than ever! Do organs have memories? Learn about the fascinating research conducted on organ transplants and cellular memory.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Plagued by persistent and frustrating body problems like dandruff, blackheads or excessive sweating? The latest installment of Ask Our Doctors shows you how to get rid of pesky ailments for good!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: If it oozes, aches or makes you blush, we’re talking about it today! From one woman’s excruciating pain “down there” to a pill-free fix for erectile dysfunction, The Doctors answers your most embarrassing questions! Could you leak breastmilk years after childbirth? The most embarrassing questions come out of our “Medical Confessional”! A celebrity stylist opens up about an embarrassing secret he’s kept under wraps for years! And, the athlete’s foot fix you can gargle with! Then, an unconventional way to relieve sinus pain that actually could work!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Bizarre in The E.R. - strange but true emergency room stories you won’t believe! Plus, “The Doctors Court” discusses how an ex-inmate is suing a jail for $5 million after he claims They ignored his 91-hour surprise erection! And, a brand new dad was arrested for selling heroin in the hospital’s maternity ward! Then, should high school students be segregated at lunchtime by their GPAs? And, don’t look now ladies, but pimple-popping nails are in vogue! Would you try them?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Get the facts about women's heart disease with singer and philanthropist Barbra Streisand, founder of the eponymous cardiovascular research program. And, cardiologist Dr. Noel Bairey shares vital tests every woman must take.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors investigates Hollywood’s Adderall epidemic. Former Hollywood “It-girl” says Adderall destroyed her life. What’s behind the increase in adult ADHD and is it a valid diagnosis? Safer alternatives for stimulant drugs. A procedure that gives a keyhole pout.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: I am a Munchausen by Proxy victim! Woman breaks her silence on medical abuse after several medical records and Doctors suggest her own mother intentionally kept her sick! Could the allegations be true? Win big prizes with The Word of The Day Giveaway!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Can what lurks in your home put your health at risk? Learn what harmful home substance may put you and your family at risk of lung cancer and how to keep your water safe.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Common Medical Risks On The Go
programme.desc: Behind the wheel, in a plane or on a train, learn how to avoid injuries and stay safe while on the go. And, Dr. Travis’ fun and safe workout tips for busy moms.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Learn the truth about your best and worst health habits in an all-new hour with Dr. Travis! Concerned about the recent meningitis outbreak? Get must-know info to keep your family safe. Plus, new, FDA-approved weight loss pills. Could they work for you? The Doctors dress up as their favorite talk show hosts! And, Modern Family star Julie Bowen shares her spookiest health story. Could it happen to you? Plus, the candy that’s as harmful to your teeth as battery acid and more hair-raising health statistics.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Why is This Happening to Me?
programme.desc: From bed wetting to plantar warts, The Doctors answer the big question: why is this happening to me? Don’t miss the simple procedure that eliminates crow’s feet, and find out Dr. Ordon’s tips to prevent them from forming!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors tackle topics from the bedroom to the bathroom that make even the most stalwart blush. Hear S-E-X-planations for how to turn up the heat in the bedroom, and get solutions for ugly feet, spider veins and more!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: In a THE DOCTORS exclusive, meet the father who had to have his hands and feet amputated after an extremely rare case of strep throat! Don’t miss the moment his family gets the surprise of a lifetime! Then, reality TV star and model Courtney Stodden reaches out to THE DOCTORS for help with depression and drugs and speaks out about her controversial marriage and rocky relationship with her mother! Plus, a doctor’s fight to save his brother’s life requires he become a donor! Then, a guest who was addicted to eating clay pots returns; has she kicked her strange habit for good?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: t’s the plastic surgery show! Heidi Montag reveals her latest plastic surgery procedures and her regrets! GG from Shahs of Sunset dishes on her plastic surgery obsession and reality star Tiffany Pollard shares how cosmetic surgery completely changed her life. Plus, see how the Kardashian’s doctor boosts the booty without a scalpel in just 30 minutes! Go inside the OR to see the surgeries to give you sexy bedroom eyes, a perfect pout, and the ideal hourglass figure!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Marriage, work, motherhood and stress can take a toll on your health, as well as your looks. Actress and author Lisa Rinna joins The Doctors to lend insight on how to get your sexy back, and look and feel your best at any age!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Inside The ER with Dr. Travis Stork
programme.desc: Get an inside look at real-life trauma and drama as The Doctors follows Dr. Travis into the E.R. And, The Triplets, whose baby girls are all approaching their first birthday, are back! Get the answers to their biggest new-mom questions!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Do you get body tremors? Does your butt jiggle? Do you tremble when you get a high fever? Learn why your body shakes, shimmies and shivers! And, shake your way to a better physique.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Ways To Take Charge Of Your Health
programme.desc: Is a simple seasoning the culprit for expanding waistlines? Most Americans consume two to three times the amount of salt necessary per day. The Nutrition Twins, registered dieticians, believe excess salt is largely to blame for America’s obesity epidemic. Learn their secret to staying skinny and try the diet designed to kick the salt habit for good! THE DOCTORS joins forces with Iams pet food to support Iams’ Home 4 the Holidays pet adoption program. Learn the health benefits of pets, for both humans and animals alike! A controversial court ruling in a worker’s compensation case may change the way employers hire. Will your weight jeopardize your job prospects? Plastic surgeon Dr. Drew Ordon demonstrates the latest wrinkle-relaxer on 35-year-old Jennifer. See the amazing after results! If you’re trying to lose weight, studies have shown that when you eat may be more important than what you eat. Snacking at the wrong time can increase your weight gain by 50 percent! Find out when to nibble and when to just say no. Pediatrician Dr. Jim Sears uncovers hidden choking dangers for toddlers and demonstrates what to do if your child’s airway is obstructed.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Insta-famous fitness star Abby Pollock is known for her “peach booty” that’s so perfect some say it’s fake! A live glute ultrasound reveals the truth, while Abby shares a shocking admission about her past. When a bad habit becomes debilitating, a woman turns to The Doctors for help! Special correspondent Rosie Mercado joins The Doctors and is shocked to hear that people are putting apple cider vinegar… down where? Is there any truth to the internet rumor urging women to try DIY “tightening”? Could a contraceptive gel for men change birth control forever? Should you stay friends with your ex? Hear what The Doctors has to say! Then, Dr. Travis tears up as he talks about his beloved dog, Nala, and her health struggles. A 97-year-old record-breaking sprinter … how does he do it? And, the easiest way to peel garlic, ever!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Decipher the clues and warning signs your body is giving you. Witness a life-saving surgery that a mother and daughter underwent together! Plus, learn what kind of bruises can indicate a serious medical condition.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: School Field Trip To Gun Range?
programme.desc: Shock and outrage as a group of students, as young as 6 years old, go on a field trip to a gun range! Plus, a new way your antibiotics could put you at risk for superbugs! Then, actress Roselyn Sanchez is joined by her husband and actor Eric Winter to reveal their pregnancy secret. Next, in a THE DOCTORS exclusive, the hero becomes the victim when a lawyer’s life is changed forever by one of the most brutal cases of domestic violence. Plus, could you get a life-threatening infection at the beach?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: End chronic snoring, learn when a birthmark is a sign of something more serious and why your child gets sick at school. Plus, why Brussels sprouts may erase wrinkles better than Botox.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Plagued by rumors of crack use, meth use, cancer and his HIV status, pop star Aaron Carter comes to The Doctors in a world exclusive to find out what’s really going. Can Aaron on be saved from The wreckage of superstardom?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Ask Our Docs: Where, When and Why
programme.desc: From when your child should start talking to why hormones affect your mood, The Doctors tackles your biggest who, what, where, when and why questions. And, get the most effective home remedies from around the globe.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: A family fed up with their mother’s years of alcohol abuse turns to THE DOCTORS for help! Will she finally quit her drinking and accept that she needs to go to rehab? Then, do you believe in past lives? We meet a mom who says her son is the reincarnation of Major League Baseball player Lou Gehrig! Plus, elementary school drop-off lines are stressful, but why would a mom pull a gun on another mom? A woman disfigured by her ex when he threw acid in her face receives a life-changing facial procedure! Don’t miss her transformation!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Learn why your food spoils faster than it should, how long an unsightly pimple will last and the maximum hours of TV your child should be watching. Plus, the most effective one-hour workout!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Investigation into home food sensitivity tests – are they legit or a waste of a time and money? Shocking story of mom’s debilitating stimulant addiction! Class action lawsuit over vitamin shots? The craziest things dogs have eaten in “My Dog Ate What?”

programme.sub-title: Reality TV Star Wants A New Butt
programme.desc: In a The Doctors exclusive, Teen Mom OG star Farrah Abraham stops by for a consultation for butt implants! Then, we meet a New York City man who recently made press for being a free sperm donor with 22 children and counting! And, a weight loss plan based on your poop, does it work?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Top Reasons People Call In Sick
programme.desc: Sore throat, upset stomach, aches and pains -- find out when you’re most contagious and when it’s safe to go back to school or the office. And, how to determine if your child is too sick for school.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: A stressed out mom has a “manic mom makeover!” Plus, a reality star using coffee enemas to cure his cancer? Then, a paralyzed man walks again by using his brain to move his legs! And one woman’s dramatic reveal after having life changing surgery for her scarred face.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: What to Do if Disaster Strikes
programme.desc: When disaster strikes, would you know what to do? Are you prepared for earthquakes, tornadoes, hurricanes, blizzards and more? Plus, five things you can do to increase your chance of surviving a plane crash.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: People know that smoking causes cancer and continue to puff anyway, but could you be doing something you didn’t know was bad for you? The Doctors reveals some of the health mistakes you never knew you were making.

programme.desc: A teenage girl is bullied because of her painful skin condition; will The Doctors be able to save her skin? Then, The Doctors discusses the latest health news. Dr. Ordon reveals the latest nip-tuck trends, including a “No Downtime Neckline” procedure to help you say goodbye to your double chin! Plus, find out how you can fight wrinkles in your sleep!

programme.desc: Actress Sally Field joins The Doctors to raise awareness about osteoporosis, a bone-thinning disease that affects four times more women than men. Learn steps to take to preserve the health of your bones.

programme.desc: Hoarder update from social media star Glozell. Skin removal surgery shocker! Eyelid popping! Can fish oil improve your sperm count?

programme.desc: Have no fear this Halloween! The Doctors reveals tricks for treating your health! Dr. Ordon shares spooktacular at-home skin treatments. And, nutritious Halloween candy!

Лице в лице S1 E1 Акулите се смятат за океански убийци, но дали са такива? Родолф Гиняр се гмурка с тях във Флорида и Бахамите, открива изненадващи взаимодействия и задава въпрос дали е възможно съвместно съществуване.
Лице в лице S1 E2 Родолф Гиняр изследва как хора и крокодили съжителстват отблизо в Мексико; въпреки първичните страхове, той открива, че тези древни влечуги са любопитни, мирни и рядко са опасни.
Живот при температури под нулата S4 E3 Зимното планиране започва да се проваля за жителите на Аляска, докато се подготвят за предстоящото замръзване.

Живот при температури под нулата S4 E4 Сю Айкънс се завръща и открива опасен хищник, дебнещ точно извън лагера. Междувременно езерото пред хижата на Глен е замръзнало, така че условията са идеални за намиране на гъша трева.
Живот при температури под нулата S4 E5 Късното замръзване на Арктика представлява уникално предизвикателство за жителите на Аляска, докато те се опитват да събират храна и припаси за оцеляване.

Живот при температури под нулата S4 E6 Ремонти, лов и поръчения са в списъка със задачи на петима жители на Аляска, които се борят да се справят с ежедневната рутина, докато дългата, тъмна зима се задава.

Живот при температури под нулата S4 E7 Зимата наближава. Жителите на Аляска се борят с различни препятствия, за да си осигурят успешен сезон. Анди ловува, за да попълни запасите си от месо. Сю се изправя лице в лице с най-големия си страх.

Ветеринарят от Хайландс S1 E3 Гай помага на раждащата чихуахуа Хайди. Дейвид премахва бучка от гърба на морското свинче Джефри, Том помага на шетландското пони на едно семейство, а Шонди лекува змия в спасителния център.

Ветеринарят от Хайландс S1 E4 Шонди помага на бременни овце, бенгалският котарак Харви се нуждае от кръвна трансплантация, Гай трябва да премахне бучка на куче Ваймаранер, Дейвид преглежда гекона Дейзи, а Бриджит оперира прасенце.

Тайният свят на звуците с Дейвид Атънбъроу S1 E3 Най-опасният момент в живота на едно животно е самото му начало. Проследяваме новородени, които използват звук, за да съобщят за пристигането си, да молят за храна и да търсят помощ.

Атънбъро за чудото на песента От песента на най-големия лемур до тази на гърбатия кит, сър Дейвид Атънбъро избира любимите си записи от природния свят, които са революционизирали разбирането ни за песента.

Дивата Белгия S1 E3 Белгийските гори крият същества с необичайно поведение; мраволъвите яростно дърпат плячката си в пясъчни фунии да нахранят ларвите си, а росянките ловят непредпазливи насекоми с лепкавите си пипала.

Най-смъртоносните природни явления в света S2 E8 Опустошителни кални потоци изравняват със земята калифорнийската крайбрежна общност Монтесито. Внезапно наводнение помита неопитен каякар в Южна Африка.

Една дива ирландска година S1 E4 Докато хората се оттеглят на закрито, дивите животни трябва да останат навън и да се борят с предстоящото сурово време. Които могат да се подготвят, го правят преди да се скрият в зимните си убежища.

Лице в лице S1 E3 Родолф се гмурка в ледени води от Салишко море до Норвегия, за да види дали можем да живеем с косатките - интелигентни, живеещи в семейства страховити хищници, чиято съдба е тясно свързана с нашата.

Най-смъртоносните природни явления в света S2 E8 Опустошителни кални потоци изравняват със земята калифорнийската крайбрежна общност Монтесито. Внезапно наводнение помита неопитен каякар в Южна Африка.

Тексаски спасители на алигатори S1 E9 Нов стажант е натоварен със задачата да помогне на екипа да извади алигатор от 6-метров кладенец, а Кали и Шанън спасяват алигатор, който се навърта близо до киносалон.
Живот при температури под нулата S4 E3 Зимното планиране започва да се проваля за жителите на Аляска, докато се подготвят за предстоящото замръзване.

Живот при температури под нулата S4 E4 Сю Айкънс се завръща и открива опасен хищник, дебнещ точно извън лагера. Междувременно езерото пред хижата на Глен е замръзнало, така че условията са идеални за намиране на гъша трева.
Живот при температури под нулата S4 E5 Късното замръзване на Арктика представлява уникално предизвикателство за жителите на Аляска, докато те се опитват да събират храна и припаси за оцеляване.

Разглеждане на Европа с нощен влак S1 E3 В този епизод разглеждаме защо хората и природата се нуждаят от тъмнината. Напускаме Будапеща в Магическия час. Докато слънцето изгрява над планините на Швейцария, научаваме за образуването на Алпите.

Дивата Виена Виена е един от най-биологично активните градове в света; дивата природа процъфтява в нейните дворци, църкви и градини, а Донауинзел служи както за контрол на наводненията, така и за зона за отдих.

Лосовете от Мацалу - дивите гиганти на Прибалтика Малцина знаят, че изключително голяма колония от лосове живее в Национален парк Мацалу край Балтийско море; проследяваме два едногодишни лоса през първата година на приемане сред възрастните лосове.

Скандинавия S1 E1 Зимата в Скандинавия се характеризира с полярната нощ, месеци, през които слънцето едва се вижда; този епизод показва как хората, животните и растенията се адаптират към тези екстремни условия.

Скандинавия S1 E2 Най-дългият ден в годината се чества в края на юни в цяла Скандинавия; в този епизод ставаме свидетели на това как животните и растенията се адаптират към предизвикателствата на полярния ден.

Еволюция S1 E1 Патрик изследва как животът е процъфтял на нашата планета - от предизвикващи гравитацията жирафи до устойчиви на радиация гъбички; може ли природата да ни научи как да изследваме извънземните светове?
Еволюция S1 E2 Патрик изследва най-важния двигател на еволюцията: оцеляването. Той среща животни, които са се адаптирали с времето, и открива как те пораждат вдъхновение за нови технологии.

Възходът на птиците S1 E1 Историята на птиците започва преди 220 милиона години. Наскоро е открита най-древната вкаменелост на съвременна птица, даваща нови данни как и защо само те са оцелели след астероида, ударил Земята.

Възходът на птиците S1 E2 Историята на птиците започва преди 220 милиона години. Наскоро е открита най-древната вкаменелост на съвременна птица, даваща нови данни как и защо само те са оцелели след астероида, ударил Земята.

Предупреждение за комари: новата тропическа заплаха за Европа Тропически болести като денга, малария, чикунгуня и вирусът на Западен Нил дълго време се смятаха за далечен проблем. Но сега те пристигнаха в Европа. Колко голяма е опасността на прага ни?

Чудните насекоми S1 E1 Разглеждаме разнообразието, красотата и вълнуващите стратегии на мравките в съответните им местообитания. Независимо дали са в Южна Америка или в Европа, светът на мравките е пълен с изненади.

programme.title: Victorious: Car, Rain, & Fire

programme.title: Victorious: Tori & Jade's Play Date

programme.title: Victorious: The Gorilla Club

programme.desc: When a movie shoot causes a traffic jam and interferes with Tori's morning commute, she turns to her friends for help. Meanwhile, Cat becomes addicted to an email coupon service.

programme.desc: Andre, Jade, Cat, and Beck trade urban legends about how Trina got accepted into Hollywood Arts. Meanwhile, Tori and Robbie are stuck at Nozu unable to pay their bill.

programme.title: Victorious: Crazy Ponnie
programme.desc: A strange new student named Ponnie befriends Tori but keeps disappearing around other people. Everyone worries Tori might be losing it, but Tori suspects that something more sinister is afoot.

programme.title: Victorious: The Blonde Squad

The intensity continues with a masterclass in mixed doubles featuring the powerful pairing of Lee Hwang Nam and Carlota Trevino facing off against Pune's consistent stars, William Sobeck and Magdalena Gregorio. Every point is a desperate grind for survival as these two titans battle through "world class" rallies for a guaranteed spot in the grand finale.

programme.title: Hopscotch
programme.desc: A disgruntled CIA agent quits the service after office politics confine him to a desk job. He heads to Europe, where he links up with a former lover (and fellow ex-agent). All goes smoothly until the CIA agent acts on advice of yet another retired agent, a former Russian rival, who suggests he write a tell-all autobiography. Spitefully, the agent sends out copies of his first chapter to the heads of CIA agencies throughout the world--and from that point on, he and his companion don't have a moment's peace. This delights him now that all of his former colleagues are chasing after him - he has a reason to get up in the morning.

programme.title: Season Of The Witch
programme.desc: A 14th-century Crusader returns to a homeland devastated by the Black Plague. A beleaguered church, deeming sorcery the culprit of the plague, commands the two knights to transport an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will perform a ritual in hopes of ending the pestilence. A priest, a grieving knight, a disgraced itinerant and a headstrong youth who can only dream of becoming a knight join a mission troubled by mythically hostile wilderness and fierce contention over the fate of the girl. When the embattled party arrives at the abbey, a horrific discovery jeopardises the knight's pledge to ensure the girl fair treatment, and pits them against an inexplicably powerful and destructive force.

programme.title: Filly Brown
programme.desc: FILLY BROWN is an inspiring and gritty portrait of a young artist striving to find her voice and seize her dreams without compromise. Majo Tonorio, aka, "Filly Brown" is a young, raw hip-hop artist who spits rhymes from the heart. With a mother in prison and a father struggling to provide for his daughters, Majo knows that a record contract could be her family's ticket out. But when a record producer offers her a shot at stardom, she is suddenly faced with the prospect of losing who she is as an artist, as well as the friends who helped her reach the cusp of success. Fueled by a fierce hip-hop score, FILLY BROWN is propelled by an exceptional cast featuring Gina Rodriguez, Lou Diamond Phillips, Edward James Olmos and the legendary Jenni Rivera in her final on-screen performance.

En cette soirée d'ouverture de la terrasse, tous sont inquiets : les orages guettent et le réseau électrique est fragile à la campagne. Le Old Mill devra-t-il fermer pour la soirée ? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Embarquement
programme.desc: En soixante ans, Abu Dhabi est passé d'un désert presque stérile à la métropole et capitale des Émirats arabes unis. Face aux défis climatiques, l'ambition du projet Abu Dhabi 2030 est de répondre aux développements de la capitale, sans oublier l'identité culturelle et environnementale de l'émirat. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Histoires et leçons
programme.desc: Les histoires voyagent à travers le temps et l'espace et portent des valeurs humaines universelles. Un conte venu d'un pays différent à chaque épisode ! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: La cabane à histoires
programme.desc: Quatre meilleurs amis ont un secret : après l'école, ils grimpent dans leur cabane cachée dans les arbres. Elle renferme un trésor inestimable : des livres ! Jour après jour, les enfants se racontent des histoires et voyagent ainsi dans des univers féériques et palpitants. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: My Class
programme.desc: Orthographe, grammaire, conjugaison : ces notions essentielles du français sont abordées par des enseignants de manière ludique afin d'accompagner les enfants, du CM1 à la 6e. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Les nouvelles aventures de Kaeloo
programme.desc: Au Pays-Trop-Mignon, Kaeloo, Moignon, Coin-Coin et Monsieur Chat jouent chaque jour à un nouveau jeu. Ils adorent inventer plein de règles inédites et se poser des questions sur le monde qui les entoure : avec eux, rien n'est jamais acquis ! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Dessine les animaux avec Koumi
programme.desc: Koumi, 6 ans, gaie et espiègle, rêve de connaître tous les animaux du monde. En plus de ça, elle adore dessiner. Dans chaque épisode, elle explique comment bien dessiner les animaux. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Ta vie sans ça
programme.desc: Quelle serait notre vie sans les objets du quotidien ? Dans chaque épisode, l'un d'entre eux est mis en avant. Qu'il s'agisse de la valise, du chronomètre ou de la fourchette, ils ont tous une histoire à raconter à propos de leur création et de leur évolution. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Jad et ses soeurs
programme.desc: Ranya et Syrine, deux soeurs jumelles, sont aussi adorables qu'inséparables. Leur vie est joyeuse et pleine de petites aventures du quotidien. Mais tout va être chamboulé avec l'arrivée de leur petit frère, Jad. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Les inventifs
programme.desc: Kayla a eu une idée lumineuse afin de faciliter le travail des chirurgiens : une lumière opératoire automatique. Ruby et Rhéa viennent à la rescousse des parents avec le thermo-dodo, un dispositif pour surveiller la température des bébés à distance. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Il est une fois
programme.desc: Les contes traditionnels se réinventent avec un Petit Chaperon belge, un loup motard, un canard pondant des oeufs d'or et des cochons corses. De Marseille à Montréal jusqu'à Brazzaville, cette série décalée et réjouissante transforme les personnages familiers de ces histoires bien connues en versions plus en phase avec l'époque contemporaine.

programme.title: Roi Keïta
programme.desc: Niani, en Afrique, dans les années 1250, une prophétie vient de se réaliser. Soundiata Keita a vaincu le terrible Soumangourou Kanté et accède à la tête de l'Empire du Mali. Il instaure une nouvelle charte protectrice des Droits de l'Homme : la "charte du Mandé". Désormais, l'esclavage est interdit et chaque être humain est libre de ses actes...

programme.title: Hiveraganza
programme.desc: Le collège Durocher Saint-Lambert contre l'école Félix-Leclerc de Pointe-Claire Les élèves du collège Durocher Saint-Lambert et de l'école secondaire Félix-Leclerc de Pointe-Claire s'affrontent aux jeux \" à la pelle \" et \" yéti pareil \". (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Foot GO
programme.desc: Tata, 8 ans, arrive dans une nouvelle école. Elle veut intégrer l'équipe de football de l'établissement mais on lui refuse, car elle est une fille. Qu'à cela ne tienne : Tata va monter sa propre équipe féminine avec l'aide de sa bande d'amis. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Foot GO
programme.desc: Tata, 8 ans, arrive dans une nouvelle école. Elle veut intégrer l'équipe de football de l'établissement mais on lui refuse, car elle est une fille. Qu'à cela ne tienne : Tata va monter sa propre équipe féminine avec l'aide de sa bande d'amis. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Mission info
programme.desc: L'émission d'information des 7-11 ans ! Chaque épisode, pensé pour les enfants et leurs parents, offre un éclairage accessible aux plus jeunes, en mêlant explications, reportages immersifs, interviews d'experts. Un quiz ludique invite également les enfants à tester leurs connaissances de manière amusante. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Mediterraneo
programme.desc: En Tunisie, la filière piscicole marine est en plein développement. Au sud de l'Italie, la mafia locale, la Camorra, exploite un vaste trafic de déchets au mépris de l'environnement. Enfin, découverte de Villanova, quartier historique emblématique de la ville de Cagliari, en Sardaigne.

programme.title: Ramdam
programme.desc: La Collection de l'Art Brut de Lausanne fête ses 50 ans. Musée pionnier, riche de pièces incroyables, il est célèbre dans le monde entier. On y découvre des créations bouleversantes et des génies marginaux, souvent méprisés et incompris. Leurs oeuvres et leurs trajets de vie réveillent les esprits contestataires et racontent aussi, à leur façon, notre époque. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Objectif Monde : l'hebdo
programme.desc: Un animal sauvage dans son salon, le nouveau trafic illégal Alimenté par des vidéos virales sur les réseaux sociaux banalisant la détention d'espèces exotiques, le trafic d'animaux sauvages de compagnie gagne du terrain. Le refuge suisse Sikypark a déjà recueilli plus de 600 animaux abandonnés : tigres, suricates, loups hybrides, perroquets rares... Que se cache-t-il derrière cette mode ? Enquête.

programme.title: Maghreb-Orient Express
programme.desc: Mohamed Kaci reçoit les personnalités au coeur de l'actualité de cette partie du monde en perpétuelle ébullition. La société civile témoigne et débat en plateau des événements et des évolutions qui se produisent dans ces pays. Ce magazine est l'incontournable rendez-vous culturel en Méditerranée.

programme.title: Des racines et des ailes
programme.desc: "Terroirs d'excellence en Normandie" : Arnaud Guérin, géologue et photographe, fait découvrir les paysages qui font la singularité de la Normandie. A la tête d'un troupeau de 200 chevaux et poulains, Julie Decayeux veut faire reconnaître son lait de jument comme lait infantile. "Normandie : le génie des bâtisseurs". La Normandie abrite des joyaux d'architecture érigés par des bâtisseurs de génie.

programme.title: VF
programme.desc: Le chef Philip Chronopoulos.

programme.title: Château !
programme.desc: Joyaux de la vallée de la Loire, le château d'Azay-le-Rideau, érigé sur une île, est une icône architecturale dans laquelle les mystères de la Renaissance s'épanouissent. Dans le même style, Beauregard abrite quant à lui une galerie de plus de 300 portraits légendaires. (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: Rendez-vous de l'information et de la culture francophone proposé par la rédaction de TV5 Monde, "64' Le monde en français" met l'accent sur l'actualité mondiale, l'actualité francophone, culturelle, politique, économique, sociale, et sociétale ainsi que sur l'information développée par les partenaires historiques de TV5 Monde : la RTBF, la RTS, Radio Canada, Télé-Québec, France 2, France 3.

programme.title: Terriennes
programme.desc: Les activités pédagogiques visent à combattre les clichés et les idées reçues, à dénoncer le sexisme, à prendre conscience de la condition des femmes dans le monde.

programme.desc: Rendez-vous de l'information et de la culture francophone proposé par la rédaction de TV5 Monde, "64' Le monde en français" met l'accent sur l'actualité mondiale, l'actualité francophone, culturelle, politique, économique, sociale, et sociétale ainsi que sur l'information développée par les partenaires historiques de TV5 Monde : la RTBF, la RTS, Radio Canada, Télé-Québec, France 2, France 3.

programme.title: Parlons Eco
programme.desc: Le rendez-vous économique de la rédaction de TV5MONDE présenté par Vicky Bogaert. \" Parlons éco \" analyse les grandes tendances du moment et reçoit les femmes et les hommes qui entreprennent, innovent, imaginent l'économie de demain... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Papilles
programme.desc: Le chef étoilé Éric Canino nous reçoit en toute simplicité à Ramatuelle, dans son restaurant La Voile et à l'hôtel La Réserve, près de Saint-Tropez. Une belle occasion de redécouvrir les charmes uniques de cette Provence côtière et de partager sa passion pour les produits du terroir. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Rassemblance
programme.desc: Élu meilleur sommelier de Suisse en 2015, Jérôme est l'ambassadeur du chasselas dans le canton de Vaud. Il est pourtant né loin des vignes, en Côte d'Ivoire, où il s'est d'abord formé à l'hôtellerie. Aujourd'hui installé au coeur des vignobles du Léman, il fait du vin un langage mêlant mémoire et culture. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: L'invité
programme.desc: 7 jours sur 7 Patrick Simonin rencontre les artistes, les écrivains, les acteurs et tous ceux qui font vibrer notre époque. \" L'invité \" est le rendez-vous incontournable des stars et des personnalités qui font l'actualité. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Merci Professeur
programme.desc: Bernard Cerquiglini décortique les curiosités de la langue française et détaille les règles de grammaire, d'accords, ou les tournures de phrases parfois curieuses.

programme.title: Football : Ligue 1 McDonald's
programme.desc: 8e journée. RC Lens/Paris FC. Stade Bollaert-Delelis (Lens). 1re mi-temps. Commentaires : Éric Rabesandratana, Manuel Tissier (Senderinfo).

programme.title: La Route du Rhum – Destination Guadeloupe
programme.desc: Résumé quotidien de la Route du Rhum 2026 – Destination Guadeloupe, course transatlantique en solitaire qui relie, tous les quatre ans, Saint-Malo, en Bretagne, à Pointe-à-Pitre, en Guadeloupe. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Lio
programme.desc: 1979. Lio, 16 ans, interprète son célèbre \" Banana split \". Mais derrière les refrains légers et les paillettes, celle qui a été tour à tour lolita puis icône pop acidulée, n'a jamais cessé de dénoncer les violences faites aux femmes. Portrait intime d'une artiste libre, au parler fort. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Les 50 ans de Sttellla
programme.desc: En 2025, Jean-Luc Fonck, le membre le plus connu de Sttellla, fête les 50 ans du premier concert de son groupe. Retour sur la vie, la carrière et l'oeuvre du chanteur, poète et humoriste belge. Un film pour découvrir les multiples facettes de cet artiste populaire. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: OPJ
programme.desc: Le port industriel de La Réunion est en ébullition. Un des vigiles a posé des explosifs pour faire sauter un container. Cet ex-militaire souffre-t-il d'un syndrome post-traumatique ou est-il juste un père dépassé qui tente de venir en aide à sa fille ? Scénario : Eugénie Dard, Juliette Gilot (Senderinfo).
